subject: Setting the Record Straight
body:
Peter,The truth is that Brad Schneider is a **weak incumbent** and our District **can be flipped to a District that puts families first** \- economically, socially, and politically. Over a third of our friends and neighbors have **no opinion or have never heard of him** \- despite a **full decade in office where he has not passed a single bill into law**. You are currently represented by a tax hiking, partisan politician who has voted blindly with Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi **97% of the time**. That is **NOT** reflective of our District - one known for intellectual leadership and independence - not one that falls in line with far-left San Francisco politics. Congressman Schneider has attempted to discredit our campaign and supporters. He has called us "_**MAGA 'exotics'** working to undermine our democratic form of government_" and said that "_the Republican establishment is pouring money into this race, and the**MAGA extremists** are mobilizing to try to flip this seat. We can't let someone who thinks that **insurrectionists** are worthy of support win._" He has opined that "t _he forces behind Trump's fundraising surge are also working to flip IL-10_ " and that our candidacy is a "_**threat**_."**Let 's set the record straight. I am running as an independent, compassionate, and common-sense business leader who believes in economic prosperity, safe neighborhoods, and a strong national presence on the global stage**. It's time for a change in leadership in our District.As your next Congressman, I promise to:
* Work across the aisle and be a uniting force between Republicans and Democrats to **get things moving in Washington** for the benefit of our families
* Get us back to energy independence, vote to **extend the tax cuts and jobs act** set to expire next year, and **create economic incentives** for our District - especially those cities and villages that need to spur economic growth like North Chicago, Waukegan, and Zion
* **Fund our law enforcement agencies** and support their capabilities to **enforce our laws and make our communities safer**
* Support our allies, **including Israel** , and serve the needs of the Jewish families in the 10th District
* **Secure our Southern Border**
* **Address the surging mental health crisis** in our District alongside the **epidemic of fentanyl and opioid overdoses** that plague some of our most vulnerable residents - children, veterans, and the elderly

Lastly, I must address Schneider's generalizations and assertions about our supporters - who he has dubbed "**a wave of dark money in this race.** " Our supporters are **hard-working, tax-paying Americans like yourself** who just want to take care of their families and their country. Your hard-earned money - **which the current Congressman is not fighting to keep in your wallet** \- is one of the many ways you can control the results of November 5. **Help us make sure that your neighbors and communities hear the right message - our message** \- not the lies that our opponent is spreading. **Would you donate $25 today to make sure that we can continue to make sure our platform reaches all the corners of the 10th? ** [DONATE $25 TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekullc-tlidtddjku-r/) Thanks,
Team Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekullc-tlidtddjku-y/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekullc-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekullc-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekullc-tlidtddjku-i/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-ekullc-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-ekullc-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-ekullc-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-ekullc-l-u) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-ekullc-tlidtddjku-o/)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88729927/484965707/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzUyYTNmMy1lNzNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CsheRDjRIJMG9bGEx7FijChUVpzPi1p6b1jyWy3zbpw=&emci=adb24f65-e73f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=1c52a3f3-e73f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=19445147)

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88729929/484965709/1610638071?refcode=em20240711pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1c52a3f3-e73f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzUyYTNmMy1lNzNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CsheRDjRIJMG9bGEx7FijChUVpzPi1p6b1jyWy3zbpw=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**
[**Please, if you’re able to, will you consider chipping in to my campaign today to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the country, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88729930/484965710/1610638071?refcode=em20240711pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1c52a3f3-e73f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzUyYTNmMy1lNzNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CsheRDjRIJMG9bGEx7FijChUVpzPi1p6b1jyWy3zbpw=)

clean_body: Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. Hello, Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before Roe v. Wade ... = Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats. Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue. My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy. Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not. What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages. Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor. I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme. Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for letting me share some of my story with you. | Hi there, I hope you are well. I am excited to send along my monthly Finance Director update from the California Democratic Party: (1) We are extremely encouraged by a spike of donations in the last few weeks. These have been driven by exciting polling that shows us leading or in the margin of error in multiple targeted Republican U.S. House seats. (2) We are moving faster than ever to deploy resources to every single competitive district across the state. (3) But with many critical donors still seeing California as a blue state at the Presidential level, contributions have not increased enough for us to *fully* fund our mobilization plan. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Stepping up to support Houstonians impacted by Beryl / Trabajando para apoyar a los habitantes de Houston afectados por Beryl
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Helping residents in need and pushing for the climate policy solutions Texans deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Hurricane%20Beryl%20flooding%20.jpg]
Houston has been struck by yet another powerful storm due to the devastating effects of climate change.
At a time when so many Houston area residents were just recovering from May's severe weather event, we are heartbroken to see the devastation Hurricane Beryl caused Monday in the southeast part of our state. [https://www.axios.com/2024/07/09/photos-hurricane-beryl-damage-texas] This week, TOP staff and members from San Antonio and Dallas are checking up on community members in hard-hit neighborhoods across Houston to share vital resources and assess immediate needs. Based on our experiences with past flooding and disaster relief, we’re committed to helping connect our Black and Latino communities in Houston with the recovery resources they deserve and working to win a more just disaster recovery system.
Over one million residents are still without power in the fourth-largest city in the nation as of Thursday [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/infrastructure/2024/07/11/493221/houston-power-outages-centerpoint-restoration-times-beryl-thursday/] , including many TOP members and staff. NOW is the time to call out inept, callous "leaders" like Abbott, urge FEMA to step up to serve residents, and to work toward a more reliable power grid to get us through the next time extreme weather happens. We protect us!
ACCESS AND SHARE the following links:
- List of cooling centers [https://cw39.com/community/notice-cooling-centers-across-harris-county-and-heat-safety/]
- Access food distribution sites [https://www.houstonfoodbank.org/find-help/find-food/]
- Look out for post-Beryl scammers [https://houstonlanding.org/scammers-are-likely-lurking-in-the-aftermath-of-hurricane-beryl-heres-what-to-look-out-for/]
Email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] if you or others you know are in need of immediate assistance in the aftermath of Beryl, or if you’d like to volunteer to help us do wellness checks.
NEXT SATURDAY: Helping clear records and create opportunities for Dallas residents
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Record%20expunged.jpg]
Join TOP next Saturday, July 20 from 10 a.m. - 2 p.m. for a FREE event at the Dallas TOP office (3910 Gaston Ave., Suite 250) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their criminal records. Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared.
Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement.
REGISTER HERE! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdkmv_aGCbSEUzSZNYnrlqgwYsRKwSZLdDboJ-Zqp2jM-J7hA/viewform]
Shouting out a Dallas TOP member for elevating our housing justice campaign
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eric%20Mata.jpg]
In June, TOP's Dallas Housing Justice campaign made headlines when tenants at Meadows at Ferguson Apartments in Dallas held a press conference, speaking out against their landlord, as their calls to fix dangerous, unlivable conditions had been ignored after severe storms in May caused structural damage to the property. Watch press coverage of the action here. [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/tenants-northeast-dallas-apartment-complex-living-in-dangerous-conditions/287-66182de0-c059-4830-8c56-09256dabe1c2?emci=75ad730d-852e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1e2ecad9-912e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=13522]
As a result of this public noise made, the City of Dallas is now taking action to improve conditions at the complex [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/dallas-county/dallas-files-petition-to-improve-living-conditions-at-meadows-at-ferguson-in-east-dallas/287-c10ee9df-6cd9-4fbf-81ce-0bdf3cb83a02] . From the start of this campaign to now, longtime Dallas TOP member Eric Mata has been working closely with Meadows at Ferguson tenants to help them have their voices heard, and we want to give him a special shout out.
Thank you, Eric, for your organizing and commitment to housing justice across Dallas!
To get involved in our fight for these tenants and for housing justice in Dallas, contact Iman Bouzid at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tips: Capture better phone pics during your summer vacation
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Better%20phone%20pics%20photos.jpg]
Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community, utilize these quick, easy tips [https://www.blurb.com/blog/take-better-photos-with-your-phone/] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments, and have fun in the process!
Español
Estamos ayudando a los residentes necesitados e impulsando las soluciones de políticas climáticas que los tejanos merecen
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Hurricane%20Beryl%20flooding%20.jpg]
Houston ha sido azotada por otra poderosa tormenta debido a los efectos devastadores del cambio climático.
En un momento en que tantos residentes del área de Houston apenas se estaban recuperando del severo evento climático de mayo, estamos desconsolados al ver la devastación que el huracán Beryl causó el lunes en la parte sureste de nuestro estado. [https://www.axios.com/2024/07/09/photos-hurricane-beryl-damage-texas] Esta semana, el personal y los miembros de TOP de San Antonio y Dallas están contactando a los miembros de la comunidad en los vecindarios más afectados de Houston para compartir recursos vitales y evaluar las necesidades inmediatas. Basándonos en nuestras experiencias con inundaciones pasadas y ayuda en casos de desastre, estamos comprometidos a ayudar a conectar a nuestras comunidades negras y latinas en Houston con los recursos de recuperación que merecen y a trabajar para lograr un sistema de recuperación de desastres más justo.
1 millon de residentes de Houston siguen sin electricidad en la cuarta ciudad más grande del país hasta el jueves por la tarde, incluidos muchos miembros y personal de TOP. [https://apnews.com/article/houston-power-outages-beryl-ceb5fdc1db4d89d2376abb22bfd45d99] AHORA es el momento de denunciar a "líderes" ineptos e insensibles como Abbott, empujar a FEMA a dar un paso adelante para servir a los residentes y trabajar para lograr una red eléctrica más confiable que nos permita superar la próxima vez que ocurra un clima extremo. ¡Nos protegemos!
ACCEDE Y COMPARTE los siguientes enlaces:
- Lista de centros de refrigeración [https://cw39.com/community/notice-cooling-centers-across-harris-county-and-heat-safety/]
- Acceder a sitios de distribución de alimentos [https://www.houstonfoodbank.org/find-help/find-food/]
- Cuidado con los estafadores posteriores a Beryl [https://houstonlanding.org/scammers-are-likely-lurking-in-the-aftermath-of-hurricane-beryl-heres-what-to-look-out-for/]
Envíe un correo electrónico a Sofía López a slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] si usted u otras personas que conoce necesitan asistencia inmediata después de Beryl, o si desea ofrecerse como voluntario para ayudarnos a realizar controles de bienestar.
EL PRÓXIMO SÁBADO: Ayudando a limpiar registros y crear oportunidades para los residentes de Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Record%20expunged.jpg]
Únase a TOP el próximo sábado 20 de julio de 10 a. m. a 2 p. m. para un evento GRATUITO en la oficina TOP de Dalla s (3910 Gaston Ave., Suite 250) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan borrar sus antecedentes penales. Nuestro equipo de Right2Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial.
Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales.
¡REGISTRAR AQUÍ! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdkmv_aGCbSEUzSZNYnrlqgwYsRKwSZLdDboJ-Zqp2jM-J7hA/viewform]
Un reconocimiento a un miembro de TOP de Dallas por elevar nuestra campaña de justicia de vivienda
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eric%20Mata.jpg]
En junio, la campaña de Justicia de Vivienda de Dallas de TOP fue noticia cuando los inquilinos de Meadows en Ferguson Apartments en Dallas celebraron una conferencia de prensa, hablando en contra de su arrendador, ya que sus llamados para arreglar condiciones peligrosas e inhabitables habían sido ignorados después de que las severas tormentas en mayo causaran daños estructurales a la propiedad. Vea la cobertura de prensa de la acción aquí. [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/tenants-northeast-dallas-apartment-complex-living-in-dangerous-conditions/287-66182de0-c059-4830-8c56-09256dabe1c2?emci=75ad730d-852e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1e2ecad9-912e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=13522]
Como resultado de este ruido público, la ciudad de Dallas ahora está tomando medidas para mejorar las condiciones en el complejo. [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/dallas-county/dallas-files-petition-to-improve-living-conditions-at-meadows-at-ferguson-in-east-dallas/287-c10ee9df-6cd9-4fbf-81ce-0bdf3cb83a02] Desde el inicio de esta campaña hasta ahora, Eric Mata, miembro de Dallas TOP desde hace mucho tiempo , ha estado trabajando estrechamente con los inquilinos de Meadows en Ferguson para ayudarlos a que se escuchen sus voces, y queremos darle un reconocimiento especial.
¡Gracias, Eric, por tu organización y compromiso con la justicia en materia de vivienda en todo Dallas!
Para participar en nuestra lucha por estos inquilinos y por la justicia habitacional en Dallas, comuníquese con Iman Bouzid en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Toma mejores fotos con el teléfono durante tus vacaciones de verano

clean_body: Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] Helping residents in need and pushing for the climate policy solutions Texans deserve [] Houston has been struck by yet another powerful storm due to the devastating effects of climate change. At a time when so many Houston area residents were just recovering from May's severe weather event, we are heartbroken to see the devastation Hurricane Beryl caused Monday in the southeast part of our state. [] This week, TOP staff and members from San Antonio and Dallas are checking up on community members in hard-hit neighborhoods across Houston to share vital resources and assess immediate needs. Based on our experiences with past flooding and disaster relief, we’re committed to helping connect our Black and Latino communities in Houston with the recovery resources they deserve and working to win a more just disaster recovery system. Over one million residents are still without power in the fourth-largest city in the nation as of Thursday [] , including many TOP members and staff. NOW is the time to call out inept, callous "leaders" like Abbott, urge FEMA to step up to serve residents, and to work toward a more reliable power grid to get us through the next time extreme weather happens. We protect us! ACCESS AND SHARE the following links: - List of cooling centers [] - Access food distribution sites [] - Look out for post-Beryl scammers [] Email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] if you or others you know are in need of immediate assistance in the aftermath of Beryl, or if you’d like to volunteer to help us do wellness checks. NEXT SATURDAY: Helping clear records and create opportunities for Dallas residents [] Join TOP next Saturday, July 20 from 10 a.m. - 2 p.m. for a FREE event at the Dallas TOP office (3910 Gaston Ave., Suite 250) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their criminal records. Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared. Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement. REGISTER HERE! [] Shouting out a Dallas TOP member for elevating our housing justice campaign [] In June, TOP's Dallas Housing Justice campaign made headlines when tenants at Meadows at Ferguson Apartments in Dallas held a press conference, speaking out against their landlord, as their calls to fix dangerous, unlivable conditions had been ignored after severe storms in May caused structural damage to the property. Watch press coverage of the action here. [] As a result of this public noise made, the City of Dallas is now taking action to improve conditions at the complex [] . From the start of this campaign to now, longtime Dallas TOP member Eric Mata has been working closely with Meadows at Ferguson tenants to help them have their voices heard, and we want to give him a special shout out. Thank you, Eric, for your organizing and commitment to housing justice across Dallas! To get involved in our fight for these tenants and for housing justice in Dallas, contact Iman Bouzid at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . TOP Tips: Capture better phone pics during your summer vacation [] Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community, utilize these quick, easy tips [] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments, and have fun in the process! Español Estamos ayudando a los residentes necesitados e impulsando las soluciones de políticas climáticas que los tejanos merecen [] Houston ha sido azotada por otra poderosa tormenta debido a los efectos devastadores del cambio climático. En un momento en que tantos residentes del área de Houston apenas se estaban recuperando del severo evento climático de mayo, estamos desconsolados al ver la devastación que el huracán Beryl causó el lunes en la parte sureste de nuestro estado. [] Esta semana, el personal y los miembros de TOP de San Antonio y Dallas están contactando a los miembros de la comunidad en los vecindarios más afectados de Houston para compartir recursos vitales y evaluar las necesidades inmediatas. Basándonos en nuestras experiencias con inundaciones pasadas y ayuda en casos de desastre, estamos comprometidos a ayudar a conectar a nuestras comunidades negras y latinas en Houston con los recursos de recuperación que merecen y a trabajar para lograr un sistema de recuperación de desastres más justo. 1 millon de residentes de Houston siguen sin electricidad en la cuarta ciudad más grande del país hasta el jueves por la tarde, incluidos muchos miembros y personal de TOP. [] AHORA es el momento de denunciar a "líderes" ineptos e insensibles como Abbott, empujar a FEMA a dar un paso adelante para servir a los residentes y trabajar para lograr una red eléctrica más confiable que nos permita superar la próxima vez que ocurra un clima extremo. ¡Nos protegemos! ACCEDE Y COMPARTE los siguientes enlaces: - Lista de centros de refrigeración [] - Acceder a sitios de distribución de alimentos [] - Cuidado con los estafadores posteriores a Beryl [] Envíe un correo electrónico a Sofía López a slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] si usted u otras personas que conoce necesitan asistencia inmediata después de Beryl, o si desea ofrecerse como voluntario para ayudarnos a realizar controles de bienestar. EL PRÓXIMO SÁBADO: Ayudando a limpiar registros y crear oportunidades para los residentes de Dallas [] Únase a TOP el próximo sábado 20 de julio de 10 a. m. a 2 p. m. para un evento GRATUITO en la oficina TOP de Dalla s (3910 Gaston Ave., Suite 250) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan borrar sus antecedentes penales. Nuestro equipo de Right2Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial. Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales. ¡REGISTRAR AQUÍ! [] Un reconocimiento a un miembro de TOP de Dallas por elevar nuestra campaña de justicia de vivienda [] En junio, la campaña de Justicia de Vivienda de Dallas de TOP fue noticia cuando los inquilinos de Meadows en Ferguson Apartments en Dallas celebraron una conferencia de prensa, hablando en contra de su arrendador, ya que sus llamados para arreglar condiciones peligrosas e inhabitables habían sido ignorados después de que las severas tormentas en mayo causaran daños estructurales a la propiedad. Vea la cobertura de prensa de la acción aquí. [] Como resultado de este ruido público, la ciudad de Dallas ahora está tomando medidas para mejorar las condiciones en el complejo. [] Desde el inicio de esta campaña hasta ahora, Eric Mata, miembro de Dallas TOP desde hace mucho tiempo , ha estado trabajando estrechamente con los inquilinos de Meadows en Ferguson para ayudarlos a que se escuchen sus voces, y queremos darle un reconocimiento especial. ¡Gracias, Eric, por tu organización y compromiso con la justicia en materia de vivienda en todo Dallas! Para participar en nuestra lucha por estos inquilinos y por la justicia habitacional en Dallas, comuníquese con Iman Bouzid en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . name: Supervisor David Canepa
subject: Learn how pets can bring us closer together, and enhance our well being
body:
Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA on July 23rd! RSVP today! | | | |
---
| | |
# July 23rd in San Mateo
---
|
---
| **[](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=6542600d47&e=c0babbc643)**

Please [join us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=af9e2649cd&e=c0babbc643) to learn how pets play a role in improving physical and mental well-being for kids, families and older adults at a special event my office is holding in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday, July 23, 12 Airport Blvd., San Mateo. According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c3f756a3d2&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=90cbe96163&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=7c4378af61&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a4fb254f98&e=c0babbc643)

This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: You and I can’t let them down now
body:
K-12 education in America is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0vcdknn3ri4a8ippj2go5o7hirgtghbhq54qarg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2lfkn99oknve3jk3a5pq4fgmvefdvnv29lt1e30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdum9jm0edq0kloqngual4fh1be8c9dhvna35a20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z41vgk2odo62lfj2gb93h59s1ts0121dki305908_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs),
* [$50 helps 250 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zk7ihep1au5sgg34250jpb1vaqjs27gaj4dlr730_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztlo51pjibuak3f78es7n2jr6jidl6cfo7nvcl90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

These national educational outreach programs include teaching anyone wishing to learn with free online courses. Your gift will reach millions of Americans through _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And your support will restore excellence to K-12 education by providing thousands of children with a classical education.

You can see how much we need you. So, I have a simple question for you:

**Will you support our successful educational outreach efforts with your best tax-deductible gift?**

**When you do, you 'll reach and teach millions of Americans nationwide on behalf of liberty, including in your state, about the Constitution. Including our youngest Americans.**

You love this country. You know how important it is to educate young minds properly. And today, you can take learning directly to schools in your state and nationwide.

**That 's why I hope you'll give a generous tax-deductible contribution of $15, $25, $35, $50, or even $100 or more at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z68icchajmbeqto99213357s8osg4kf9k11ddvho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs)

I know you share our commitment, and I hope you will join us in our effort. Thank you!

For our youth,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Young minds in classrooms all across America need your help. Critical race theory and woke politics are found nationwide in K-12 classrooms, even in your state. These radical ideologies have pushed K-12 education in America to a crisis point, threatening freedom itself.

Will you support our mission to provide pocket-sized Constitutions to students in your state and advance educational resources that teach the principles of liberty? You will help millions of Americans nationwide--including our youngest Americans. **You can easily give your best gift at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjr819hpjdc898g3p27ndm1c6g5mthvnqmu04168_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7clh2bs)

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Live free from your regrets
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._Vg)
---
____Hello Friend,

If you could reach back into the past with a magical eraser and delete some of the words you've said, the actions you've taken, or the decisions you've made, would you?

Of course! We all would. Regrets are a part of every human life and can be powerful.

A poet once wisely wrote: "Of all the sad words of tongue or pen, the saddest are these: 'It might have been.'"

Regrets can bring us to a standstill, paralyzed and unable to move forward spiritually because of the fear of making more mistakes. But they also have the power to motivate us to do better, to make better choices, and to spend our time more wisely.
---
| | I don't want you to live in the shadow of regret, nor does God. I've written a new book that looks at how we can let go of every kind of regret--marital, parenting, financial, career, and more--and confidently move forward to a better future. It's called _Say Goodbye to Regrets_ , and we're making it available this month for a gift of any amount to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-YrEcPKKq0VmRg)
---
| | If living without regrets sounds like an area in which you could use some encouragement and guidance, I recommend you secure your copy today.

Get _Say Goodbye to Regrets_ here: [https://ptv.org/donate/say-goodbye-to-regret-by-dr-robert-jeffress](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)

I hope that this book will help you move forward in victory, leaving the regrets of your past behind you.

God bless you,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

name: Dave McCormick
subject: Can you take 1 minute to read this?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zm1h20osvri7ouj5bchkc2dao0m1dro3qrajsvu8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zh24k52enpob9090j89lfg38fgcc6p7t4rp76mpo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zjs0nqdtv5t7sgodamt95ivcmq248ct784ue166o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zt9ltqlot7h33vvojiqj6p9lpvm80cvbofilfvoo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z5cd1bjkt48bvq040s38mohq2e9og43l1pburpi0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

**As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there.** After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own.

**Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first.**

I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.

**I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why** **[I'm hoping you'll pitch in a donation of $17.76 or more today.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zssq2nvus1odkek1gfsk638mso3do9d84rnerjk8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)**

Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream.

**America deserves better. You deserve better.

It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves.** **[Will you join me today?](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z1r62gn4e333oi3gdsknd3n2sgfsomoq39ht9p60_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)**

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. **Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.**

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zupq6v5b3ss5n7m5l1n8tpt6okbkqpa43vbvk4k8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)
I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -**I need your help.**

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 in order to show the strength of our movement](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z1g3cp0vvfbb9huli72173b2rmaknj2k7ct5s77g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)** during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zevm81fu39hsieti9ugf68olk5ptk3hm26rtird0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z2agrjh140dnt65dbd1cjuf81vkuemf4n1cl4bdg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)**

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next Senator.**

We can revitalize the economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, and save America's future.

But in order to get the job done, it's going to take all hands on deck.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9mvgsjk4a6qeuovgfe7v93qut98k596qat1avd8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zkc8jt5ruun10ahbq69a4rm21pqgdftc2janfr18_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)

Democrats at every level are outraising their GOP opponents. Schumer's allies have committed to spend whatever it takes to obliterate my campaign because if I win, it's **IMPOSSIBLE** for Democrats to keep their Senate majority.

**[That's why we need to fuel my campaign and show the Democrats in power that we have what it takes to WIN this fight. Will you join me today?](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zk4l8roemjjuekoucfpuuof4pjsp4pjts5osa9h0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob7c9h2bs)**

I've lived the American Dream, and I can't sit back and watch it slip away for our kids. I need every freedom-loving American to help me reach the finish line. I promise I won't let you down.

Have a wonderful day!

_Dave McCormick
US Army Veteran, USMA '87
Candidate, U.S. Senate, PA_

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z584bqehromjdb33p1v8gn435casisj6668j1buo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjsvkg2fdc13uvgfipqan9dv66scl68nrb15fsj0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3615h9r43dk6gufcok2iq9lppoqevblps7lvfpo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs),
* [$50 helps 250 students](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjq37r1dbjot0qsf4ub8sr5at17ofnandt4510p8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2hrdk5nuu5oo6l8h1c5gd7a9ahpkovgsnr93cr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

These national educational outreach programs include teaching anyone wishing to learn with free online courses. Your gift will reach millions of Americans through _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And your support will restore excellence to K-12 education by providing thousands of children with a classical education.

You can see how much we need you. So, I have a simple question for you:

**Will you support our successful educational outreach efforts with your best tax-deductible gift?**

**When you do, you 'll reach and teach millions of Americans nationwide on behalf of liberty, including in your state, about the Constitution. Including our youngest Americans.**

You love this country. You know how important it is to educate young minds properly. And today, you can take learning directly to schools in your state and nationwide.

**That 's why I hope you'll give a generous tax-deductible contribution of $15, $25, $35, $50, or even $100 or more at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv5accvbet2lmlvf1cegin4p3v29iqvqfgnqma40_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs)

I know you share our commitment, and I hope you will join us in our effort. Thank you!

For our youth,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Young minds in classrooms all across America need your help. Critical race theory and woke politics are found nationwide in K-12 classrooms, even in your state. These radical ideologies have pushed K-12 education in America to a crisis point, threatening freedom itself.

Will you support our mission to provide pocket-sized Constitutions to students in your state and advance educational resources that teach the principles of liberty? You will help millions of Americans nationwide--including our youngest Americans. **You can easily give your best gift at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9lf94qcnnkl199efv6esrobslhj0nr3vhkpp3h8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctjm1ob6cjh2bs)

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: You and I can’t let them down now
body:
K-12 education in America is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjfhr9gr16jno2c27mjbflc7ejoe8dna2b9c9870_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfu4rar2p8f76if6oitj0qacalcmkn7rrj5c298g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgossem920lfngn7e8rkepo7cbc5e0v6l8ortbbo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaa3snbn23l2tv893senmg8he4njaq58lbgbruag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs),
* [$50 helps 250 students](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4f02hqfmu24ihmdg97640m78j3tcpnc0vquvoo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl02mvpcrtp58be5lodashqd2s3t4a97754oh5f0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6c9h2bs).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z24ogpd20n68vovsi0o09i9ibdsjk8qmmgbson20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc121s3sceh76krn1b084qm019vub6vtbo46lrm0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb2oc95mcf9pttduc085drp1v6pokr2qdfnghqc0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb1uoajl27c8q7jlhdr5959723tl2qnhtthk2m8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zl22lin88dj8api10un212o52sbedjla62ijl38g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

**As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there.** After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own.

**Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first.**

I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.

**I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why** **[I'm hoping you'll pitch in a donation of $17.76 or more today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6tgmp6sa4vdlspg6kov9msrh8a5alpr7c7v2r38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)**

Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream.

**America deserves better. You deserve better.

It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves.** **[Will you join me today?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhbtmpus66o7j9m3rmll2h4ir879accre2ud25j8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)**

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. **Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.**

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztbn7lmro7fshp3sbncmg2jmn05n2rf8t8r3a2r8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)
I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -**I need your help.**

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 in order to show the strength of our movement](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpnvgm0m5ouoq81h0hfqe7rsmg14c3v75ej9sh3o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)** during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5772r2phkkmp4hqij7sovdesono0mm8aaj7fbj8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6ag0cstfnos5pa0gkmhhocr1osl758pjiehgfb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)**

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next Senator.**

We can revitalize the economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, and save America's future.

But in order to get the job done, it's going to take all hands on deck.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjocv252k3n1fpnmb3n0t0esfskv6rsn99i16q70_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbd4ph3hegpd6k7flgv7i8c4bq666u1sedqhn668_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)

Democrats at every level are outraising their GOP opponents. Schumer's allies have committed to spend whatever it takes to obliterate my campaign because if I win, it's **IMPOSSIBLE** for Democrats to keep their Senate majority.

**[That's why we need to fuel my campaign and show the Democrats in power that we have what it takes to WIN this fight. Will you join me today?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z357igaidduokossr1rp8rslomkqo4f7jd77pcqg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge0oj6cjh2bs)**

I've lived the American Dream, and I can't sit back and watch it slip away for our kids. I need every freedom-loving American to help me reach the finish line. I promise I won't let you down.

Have a wonderful day!

_Dave McCormick
US Army Veteran, USMA '87
Candidate, U.S. Senate, PA_

name: Dave McCormick
subject: Can you take 1 minute to read this?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgvso5t1hcoao0srrpckkrgtb61i9af3nejk9e5g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqo2u1ujb0fa2nrpgii4il7jsn13qr7jpbgi0jd0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrmhua24pa0tp5g5vc591q8at8564vvdkkp40c3o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zq3p5a6c8v6htvu0ddubc3t67hf34pk35hl1leco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpf2t37uastdt7sgm1t7kb1l9tf8ea0s05k3ap00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

**As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there.** After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own.

**Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first.**

I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.

**I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why** **[I'm hoping you'll pitch in a donation of $17.76 or more today.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztlh3oo54nlom6amo7aq6vehst8stsni1fqlr7c0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)**

Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream.

**America deserves better. You deserve better.

It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves.** **[Will you join me today?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmm8c6v30a4arsqa9t1ltfesnktks0ptoq5knaag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)**

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. **Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.**

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4nlhe04cfv3kbiais0a93ieoo1fcjbgtpsldjio_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)
I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -**I need your help.**

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 in order to show the strength of our movement](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zups0gitipmuc1pcj7vv568ihtd79ia5ugig45cg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)** during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaaprd8bb0sbgfvsit786j6etl4if3lgkqfp33b0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn8lvkavilgp7qik8gn4issjtqnj2fnbb4lvq7v0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)**

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next Senator.**

We can revitalize the economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, and save America's future.

But in order to get the job done, it's going to take all hands on deck.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcj9aqks8dake0l005plv19rd6864ahr448d41h0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc329kjqpj5tjqg8kvne3kaft7ifpq9spr7t16f0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)

Democrats at every level are outraising their GOP opponents. Schumer's allies have committed to spend whatever it takes to obliterate my campaign because if I win, it's **IMPOSSIBLE** for Democrats to keep their Senate majority.

**[That's why we need to fuel my campaign and show the Democrats in power that we have what it takes to WIN this fight. Will you join me today?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpg8fassqpfabc7db1jdcinqfgkqppuhfu2u78tg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o34sth2bs)**

I've lived the American Dream, and I can't sit back and watch it slip away for our kids. I need every freedom-loving American to help me reach the finish line. I promise I won't let you down.

Have a wonderful day!

_Dave McCormick
US Army Veteran, USMA '87
Candidate, U.S. Senate, PA_

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: 25 Days and Counting...
body:
The primary election in Kansas is twenty-five days from today.

For over a year, I’ve worked day and night to make the case for why I am
the strongest candidate to represent KS-03 in Congress.

I believe votes should be earned—and I hope I can earn yours.
<https://kcforkansas-com.jmailroute.net/x/d?c=41617163&l=a83edc56-b500-4df1-8559-992e6e69a83a&r=5419d936-aed8-4f44-b972-b8d8d8e82135>

But the truth is, this election has never been about me. This election is
about YOU and the thousands of Kansans I’ve met who are frustrated about
the state of our nation. This election is about:

- The family who uses their oven to heat their home during the winter.
- The senior citizen who is using her retirement savings to pay her
mortgage.
- The recent college grad who had to decide between paying rent and
paying a car note... and no longer has a car to go to work.
- The single mom who is working 2 jobs and still can’t afford to put
food on the table.
- The young child who struggles to sleep at night because he’s afraid of
bad guys breaking into his home.
- The young couple who has crippling credit card debt and doesn’t feel
like there’s ever going to be a way out.

*You deserve to have a leader in Congress who isn’t afraid to ask the tough
questions, make difficult decisions, and represent your interests, not
their own, every day in every way.*

Life is hard enough as is. Politicians in Washington shouldn’t make it any
harder for you. If you send me to Congress, I can guarantee you that I will
work harder than ever to make your life easier.

As the small business owner of an award-winning HVAC and plumbing company,
I am a professional problem solver. My job is to fix systems and clean up
messes. It’s time we had someone from the skilled trades in Congress. It is
time for common sense and sanity to return to our federal government.

My opponent thinks he can buy this primary, help me prove him wrong.

Support me in the final stretch: donate $30, $130, $230, or more today.
<https://kcforkansas-com.jmailroute.net/x/d?c=41617163&l=a83edc56-b500-4df1-8559-992e6e69a83a&r=5419d936-aed8-4f44-b972-b8d8d8e82135>

Thanks for all your support - it truly means the world to me.

Fighting hard for you,

Karen Crnkovich

Candidate for Congress (KS-03)

www.kcforkansas.com
<https://kcforkansas-com.jmailroute.net/x/d?c=41617163&l=3b5cbf26-1a8f-40f0-9b10-a0d615c6800b&r=5419d936-aed8-4f44-b972-b8d8d8e82135>

You may unsubscribe
<https://kcforkansas-com.jmailroute.net/x/u?u=5419d936-aed8-4f44-b972-b8d8d8e82135>
to stop receiving our emails.

| | Dear Friend, The debates over how American history is taught are more intense than ever, impacting how students understand the foundations of our nation. In the insightful ebook from the Hoover Institution, "**How Not to Teach American History** ," David Davenport and Gordon Lloyd explore these controversies and propose new ways to approach history education.
---
| | I'm excited to offer you a free copy of this compelling ebook.

By downloading "How Not to Teach American History," you'll gain a deeper understanding of current debates and discover innovative strategies for teaching history that respect the past while engaging students in meaningful ways.

[**Download your free copy today and join the conversation about how we can better teach American history.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9v64t3g5n1o9vltroqn6ecs73f5rvlpiga46dvg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o31c9h2bs)
**Highlights from the EBook:**
* **Understanding the Controversy:** Explore the debates surrounding historical monuments, textbooks, and the portrayal of key figures.
* **Case Studies:** Learn from real-world examples, like the mural controversy at George Washington High School.
* **Teaching Strategies:** Discover the benefits of using primary documents and narratives to make history come alive for students.
* **A Balanced Approach:** Gain insights into presenting history that honors the past without political bias.

**Download your free ebook now and be part of the change in how we teach and understand American history.

**[Download Now](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zairasvd4d1vjp3pknl4kbtsfguv0gpl9isdvrig_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctge4o31c9h2bs)

body:
K-12 education in America is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~),
* [$50 helps 250 students](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

These national educational outreach programs include teaching anyone wishing to learn with free online courses. Your gift will reach millions of Americans through _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And your support will restore excellence to K-12 education by providing thousands of children with a classical education.

You can see how much we need you. So, I have a simple question for you:

**Will you support our successful educational outreach efforts with your best tax-deductible gift?**

**When you do, you 'll reach and teach millions of Americans nationwide on behalf of liberty, including in your state, about the Constitution. Including our youngest Americans.**

You love this country. You know how important it is to educate young minds properly. And today, you can take learning directly to schools in your state and nationwide.

**That 's why I hope you'll give a generous tax-deductible contribution of $15, $25, $35, $50, or even $100 or more at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HXkyOjgCeVDbXQ344HioVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoc46kP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dpdmUtc2Nob29sY2hpbGRyZW4tdGhlLWNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbi1ub3c_c2M9MDEyMDFOMDI0MkxETERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXBvY2tldGNvbnN0aXR1dGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ISUdIU0NIT09MX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDcxMlcDc3BjQgpmjpX0kGZRlz8gUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

I know you share our commitment, and I hope you will join us in our effort. Thank you!

For our youth,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Young minds in classrooms all across America need your help. Critical race theory and woke politics are found nationwide in K-12 classrooms, even in your state. These radical ideologies have pushed K-12 education in America to a crisis point, threatening freedom itself.

Will you support our mission to provide pocket-sized Constitutions to students in your state and advance educational resources that teach the principles of liberty? You will help millions of Americans nationwide--including our youngest Americans. **You can easily give your best gift at the secure link below:**
