body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyUkbFugzAQhp_GbEb2GWFn8FAJsaVDl47oMIZcigEZO1HeviJNpa6Vbvr1f3f6dJ_n7ow00zK9Y_A2hi7uxwTHJQ-05OR5Wnn0OHQgoOJCcwkdFIOtT6CNLLyVGoQ2IBQUFwujGmozCCfH0YxGGBxHAa53aJRWWBVkjz1CSxCnSktT1iiU01qAAnRVX7NKRL_lfiaHS8DrGik9ysWnYraXlLadqTcGLYN29y5HX95piX4o3RoYtMG5NQZyX3xDBu01zw_e08p9QJr5DThuyFQbDzTSMjHVpJg9gzqn0AU_UA5MNduz_0r3NUfnmWri3h34T-owbEjTwlTzMpLdca6n9Qn_qSbHVPNx5r_mRbTDdqd5pr3WrBLT0T8EivSPF9wsfAcAAP__evGPiw)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyUkbFugzAQhp_GbEb2GWFn8FAJsaVDl47oMIZcigEZO1HeviJNpa6Vbvr1f3f6dJ_n7ow00zK9Y_A2hi7uxwTHJQ-05OR5Wnn0OHQgoOJCcwkdFIOtT6CNLLyVGoQ2IBQUFwujGmozCCfH0YxGGBxHAa53aJRWWBVkjz1CSxCnSktT1iiU01qAAnRVX7NKRL_lfiaHS8DrGik9ysWnYraXlLadqTcGLYN29y5HX95piX4o3RoYtMG5NQZyX3xDBu01zw_e08p9QJr5DThuyFQbDzTSMjHVpJg9gzqn0AU_UA5MNduz_0r3NUfnmWri3h34T-owbEjTwlTzMpLdca6n9Qn_qSbHVPNx5r_mRbTDdqd5pr3WrBLT0T8EivSPF9wsfAcAAP__evGPiw)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

## Biden Goes Live in Rare Press Conference
President Biden defended his candidacy and his ability to do the job in a rare live press conference Thursday. Immediately after it ended, [two more Democratic congressmen](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQheGngY4VDFyDC4rb0G3alBaLBzMRhpUXeZW3j5w69SedI_2f9-UeqVLbPuKOfuS-xDToxMUKBQLMYvjqMyKg5uiVBWlnZcHw4tO86sc_1E4n7azL2WW0Ms84Rf1A6Th5kGCkVaCkBKVvWbo4Q8wqaj3rhMxIXGn04_bVqY2CuX73E49b6juvvozxfDH9n0FgEEbBQrVexiCUvmPD94tBSHF_Rtoag2DsNM0OxINWbOJykXrLeGBLKCqdKNJ1EDdkEPjh1-ebaqXXZJmR2x7pd5-Pv0ucHn4CAAD__2QOYN8) called on him to withdraw from the race. Biden made several flubs, one right at the beginning when he referred to VP Kamala Harris as "Vice President Trump." Earlier in the day he introduced Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky as "President Putin." [Video is here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDHToyAQQH-NdmRgIUELimvscu2Vzgpr3AuCg8SM-fU3l_qr3yvevD_38Y4cOT1-40quznlEX_mg0QoFAsxo2uBmIiDdklMWpO2VBdMuTmqYbMCe_C1cTejVFIgs9mhlmE0ILTuQYKRVoKQEpS-z7LAHnBVq3WtPjZEUuOZy-Zs51YXmeOaDysXntY1uqXXbG_2rgaGBAbdE7_0_amA4OFBuYHg9C3IikXKpi8AaMVX2ohbCeopcHpj4g5VzEkeOOZzrWcSHIqX9eZ7iiBh45SK2V-Uk0tfEKKagQteTV9Z2hm5yAmlnc_XSU6dN59viwvbmGHm_2cbIx4ocv9X154eHg38BAAD___KFd2c) The President told reporters he didn't trust the accuracy of current polls showing him trailing in the race but said delegates to the Democratic convention next month were "free to do whatever they want" in choosing a candidate. [You can watch the entire press conference here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojuDgJhYOiSLV07WgSOmIqAhVGs_n2Vzh2f3vL0vm7LzeeS6-PTP9mN1BYfRn7xYgSSILWoObrETCxndmgIjEVDal4dK8QQrY5KIaDWmpBRJpU4EgYDc3YEpMAgIQChPCW4eEs-oZfSysCTAo55tH76brmOlVP5aS_up9Cec3HrGNs-yY-JrhNd_Vb52N_qDX3kUHii69oOMZo4_AiruOfIVWyd912EVhN3roGFN3C2wOZsVApWX4DI3vVd08Um7YHm7uJ25FLyrs2k4PH0ufxFjP-XvBz9BgAA__-u8GEd) Afterward, [Reps. Jim Himes (](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GOix24Q5fQfEaunttSgvby3kjDJaN7OTvo0udeqQZzcdzeEbOXF7_40q-pTrEqfFJg1OACu1g5ewTEZKR5MGhdg9waOXikwXoU6-J7HjrzUzQ25sdTbqNLtp0l-xRo9UOELRGMF3SfXxgTBCNeZiJhNU0c6t791m5tIVS_q4n7d1UV5n90tp2CPNPYBAYruvq4hfX400FhrdbYNBOYAAQGEaeqahtp-NQUy2JdioTqVYLv5amSmxV7n7eLs6Zj7sTVr_WyPm31v5-Pz3-BAAA__9L61qh)D-Conn.) and Scott Peters (D-Calif.) both asked Biden to end his campaign. That brings to 16 the total number of Democratic legislators on record seeking his withdrawal.
## Russian Assassination Plot Foiled
The United States and Germany reportedly foiled a [Russian plot to assassinate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwwCEeGLqwpWtH68V-2LQYLCCx8vdVOne95U73dZtuGGJI6yfuZJvPE84tPGkyXAIHPelusZ4ISHVkpQFhRmlAd5sV5O9wBSk9qnkwBHD3wzBqrw0Nl8vcBQsCtDASpBAgVe_FFUdAL1GpUc3EtKAltFz67xxS28jHV35S6ee8d9FurR2VqQ8GjoE7z7NvFGkteGz9nPvHz5vmEhee6KwM3FvHwAnDwEnJwD0qx7TwlcqO6cV9DpFjjLTSwsuj1oCJY61Ya0jYQk78iLkxcF2xy3GGGEO9GKbFumOIf1nt_0lPC78BAAD__3jtaXw) Armin Papperger, CEO of Rheinmetall, a major German arms manufacturer supplying crucial weapons to Ukraine. This plot, [uncovered by U.S. intelligence services](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwQ4HVnKeBUUau0ub0tnBRTdZwUE8594-k9Tp_-Kf7_MxPZCF0_KBG_ka84Sh8pOmXlvQ4CbXzD4SAXUNeduD6Qfbg2tWH2YcIhpH8c0C3cH2N0MxuBicCQj3hj0YcKa3YI0B27XR3HEAjBa7bugCKWdo5ppL-5U51ZWivPKTShvy1ohfa90P1b0rGBWM13W1exauHHJLp4IRS-UgpGAs53Ew6l1y1d8sorFsh94wnRFDPQsVXVbitFFFER0o_xac9I77TmWhomNmoVmfh16obJheOqSkYGyKn_eLRfi49cqZZUOWv8H6P9fTw08AAAD__xNkcRk), is part of Russia's broader ongoing "hybrid war of aggression," targeting defense industry executives across Europe. [Rheinmetall, Germany's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO3CAQQL8Gd7OCMVnsgiKNu0ub0pqDsT0RBgvwRvv30aW-_knv6f3-WD9IkuT9F53s-1ZWCl1evDowCGhXO0S_MSOPA3vjULvZOLTD4fH5g4J2k3maLX7yNMY52Hm2E8fPMDs3iEeNVjuDRms042PTE81Im6FxnMfAymqO0kt9_CmS-8FbepcX10co55D80fvV1PhT4aJw4buWkyRSviq39sUoXL4MChftFC7GKFzuBpQj7FxPym_YiiSod2tCGa5UOvQC1Bq1Jpk6Qz1Y8smdUoLABULOEKRL3oFyye-z3A1auWvgpnAZqo_XX0lJ2tMpq_eTJP3v7d_fe3n8FwAA___6HnP8) largest producer of 155mm artillery shells, has been supporting Ukraine's defense efforts under a €5 billion contract. Russia is also strongly suspected of planning sabotage operations against U.S. military sites and is believed to have hired proxies to carry out an arson attack on a factory run by German arms company Diehl in May.
## Chinese Ships Spotted Near Alaska
Four [Chinese naval vessels](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQgOGngc3IPjs4DB66ZEvXjuhiH-EaYyK4YOXtq3bu_g-_vq_reEXOXO6fuFCQaR0xCh80emVAgRtdm8JEBGRbCsaD9oPx4No59OCRnO_tOcXbLZ2T9f1wiv3QGx8dYssBNDjtDRitwdhu0mccACeD1g42UuM0JZZ1675XLjLTlN_rQVsX16XNYRZ57o39aODSwKXW2hWqeyV6_AYNXOLMBVXB461ehYWS2gWFdkUlrq8itKlEE5VICjPuD1Rxxpyp3EktnFlweyszgNP61G4hPSvnzHvvG6fvC3L-G5H_WY4APwEAAP__AplmzA) were spotted by U.S. Coast Guard ships this weekend inside the U.S. exclusive economic zone of the Bering Sea, just north of Alaska's Aleutian Islands. The incident, which represented a rare incursion by the Chinese so close to American waters, occurred this past weekend but was publicly reported Thursday. A Coast Guard cutter on [a routine patrol](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnwR0WDMTEBcVt3OW2W1qTMY5nF0MEJFbefpXVltt90mmO_o_LfEGOnG7_cQ--rXlGavwMs5MaJNjZdotfQ4BguuC1A-VG7cB2mzeDJRqMhhMaq4AsaXTmDCdSONrztWMPCqxyGrRSoE2_qjOOgKtGY0ZDQVgVFm659J-ZU9vCGl_5GUpPee-i31q7V2H-CZgETMdx9OlKKRz1vQuY3hQwPar8FW2cUO4cuWF5ybrxvUqMWL9QPqqkjLXJ2wPLIgsl1IM2ynbFL_eDY-Q6OGHVbUeOPw_a3z2eHr4DAAD__xWSYpw) identified three Chinese ships about 124 miles north of the Amchitka Pass. A fourth Chinese ship was spotted 84 miles north of the Amukta Pass. Officials said all four Chinese ships were being closely [watched by U.S. forces](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RENA5i4oLgmXa690prgwZ4T_hCwifLvV9l6y6fXPL1_9-lOkmVf_tLGoaVjotjkyZNXGhXayfZzSMzIpuegPYIftUfbr4HjPHjQNCAlsNp5r8E4k_TgyZCbewkIaMFr1ACozSXBlUakpMmY0UTuLPAs7SiX_4fsbeWU38eTyyUeW5_D2tpZO_Onw1uHNzp3ftWP-kBpEjN3eIsH1aaWLyqzenCRfVGVScVVdq6sNsnSqLxVXeWsyuDgrxFjcpqGyKN7ALK9GgTnIEXXlzCfL8lZ6uA7C8tGkn9y2u9zngG_AwAA___3O2VS) to ensure there were no "disruptions." Analysts said the Chinese were testing to see how how the U.S. would react.

Chinese Ships Spotted Near Alaska Four were spotted by U.S. Coast Guard ships this weekend inside the U.S. exclusive economic zone of the Bering Sea, just north of Alaska's Aleutian Islands. The incident, which represented a rare incursion by the Chinese so close to American waters, occurred this past weekend but was publicly reported Thursday. A Coast Guard cutter on identified three Chinese ships about 124 miles north of the Amchitka Pass. A fourth Chinese ship was spotted 84 miles north of the Amukta Pass. Officials said all four Chinese ships were being closely to ensure there were no "disruptions." Analysts said the Chinese were testing to see how how the U.S. would react. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=596acd73a7c64e2eb4c99b4bc79f3faf&_e=CIyTqN6bpozZevlAC0qgTkFMJ9nDnuT-LDLajIU7b1chUFx3KLJzOr7wsvq1m5jlgQfX-toNkxAnjH7e3Rw8tdgZsDlqyI1AcAZznQ_H8annJJIec9UYK_cuTmve_QZXwJP_a2-P5PVB4mecqrHwWIE-fObbCBl5UJQGpoDGeJ5aeaWdgVcMpmsbtUwLAP_Zx6RSEjSJbbTSInw9mEqg1g6_pox6_momVPxiNFPFc57L2S89FkYWES9D_Q0vw8QtI-ImpSHT86Clhh1ooHCUcxeHKt7vS8c6q6MJ2FhHvnSj78iIn1KTws9nSb2Gd8fMk_kHrqWZ6C0seUGK8M62o8Eya5bSfQ5zlgOVW3xvEqxz_-zmzUencbFAma9IToirwzr5VPUIdAf9ui3i08QJy6Ib36ffGU0QXsfBlvY5nZiAgEvB-iHndjqwo_snNXesia38rR6D_el_T5-NIrXQXA%3D%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=596acd73a7c64e2eb4c99b4bc79f3faf&_e=CIyTqN6bpozZevlAC0qgTkFMJ9nDnuT-LDLajIU7b1chUFx3KLJzOr7wsvq1m5jlgQfX-toNkxAnjH7e3Rw8tdgZsDlqyI1AcAZznQ_H8annJJIec9UYK_cuTmve_QZXwJP_a2-P5PVB4mecqrHwWIE-fObbCBl5UJQGpoDGeJ5aeaWdgVcMpmsbtUwLAP_Zx6RSEjSJbbTSInw9mEqg1g6_pox6_momVPxiNFPFc57L2S89FkYWES9D_Q0vw8QtI-ImpSHT86Clhh1ooHCUcxeHKt7vS8c6q6MJ2FhHvnT_MFtPC2BEX0E9X15hRKbuyoZ8O1nQs2qkJhhVjqgd8FDVR1FfJJfzvB6cPwg1GOS5H6_xPBpNgVDQ1UKD53p9teHRjzMT9-1xpaxXkS3cqSV6Lm-E-JoDwzyyYxx5rBF3nIrkzeTuC26algXUpV2zMuGTin-FqOUxuQvcN4iWnQ%3D%3D),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=596acd73a7c64e2eb4c99b4bc79f3faf&_e=CIyTqN6bpozZevlAC0qgTkFMJ9nDnuT-LDLajIU7b1chUFx3KLJzOr7wsvq1m5jlgQfX-toNkxAnjH7e3Rw8tdgZsDlqyI1AcAZznQ_H8annJJIec9UYK_cuTmve_QZXwJP_a2-P5PVB4mecqrHwWIE-fObbCBl5UJQGpoDGeJ5aeaWdgVcMpmsbtUwLAP_Zx6RSEjSJbbTSInw9mEqg1g6_pox6_momVPxiNFPFc57L2S89FkYWES9D_Q0vw8QtI-ImpSHT86Clhh1ooHCUcxeHKt7vS8c6q6MJ2FhHvnR8zYZ4PVb7kyvvtjDU-99yCJ4NKf2KcWEngHMjVPr0VdfsupiHzxjXIe_ldoU1re1vTAZbJZQOHMgsjeWc5f3sBTHkkwX8T7XxBOSE8v7RGq61rYIjck844SNM7VWoqbkT2xQBMpC6lh1pc-Lm1cI3t0LWpyPgY-aXqMgifmYq4g%3D%3D),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=596acd73a7c64e2eb4c99b4bc79f3faf&_e=CIyTqN6bpozZevlAC0qgTkFMJ9nDnuT-LDLajIU7b1chUFx3KLJzOr7wsvq1m5jlgQfX-toNkxAnjH7e3Rw8tdgZsDlqyI1AcAZznQ_H8annJJIec9UYK_cuTmve_QZXwJP_a2-P5PVB4mecqrHwWIE-fObbCBl5UJQGpoDGeJ5aeaWdgVcMpmsbtUwLAP_Zx6RSEjSJbbTSInw9mEqg1g6_pox6_momVPxiNFPFc57L2S89FkYWES9D_Q0vw8QtI-ImpSHT86Clhh1ooHCUcxeHKt7vS8c6q6MJ2FhHvnQar8EWmq07-AIq3kXg6OfeyDkK1undWFaPo9f7mq6U6lnp_umBFHGkscSkdFJS_LajmKZr9CnpTTl5SkPnJ5Viy3-VddoLgHe9CA6HGXGdz56Fv8F59rejZVvxZNJdGa2GjU0zGOGA2g-Yn--hw6P0mXzaPaajGo1Oc4xwdAQpqQ%3D%3D),
* [$50 helps 250 students](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=596acd73a7c64e2eb4c99b4bc79f3faf&_e=CIyTqN6bpozZevlAC0qgTkFMJ9nDnuT-LDLajIU7b1chUFx3KLJzOr7wsvq1m5jlgQfX-toNkxAnjH7e3Rw8tdgZsDlqyI1AcAZznQ_H8annJJIec9UYK_cuTmve_QZXwJP_a2-P5PVB4mecqrHwWIE-fObbCBl5UJQGpoDGeJ5aeaWdgVcMpmsbtUwLAP_Zx6RSEjSJbbTSInw9mEqg1g6_pox6_momVPxiNFPFc57L2S89FkYWES9D_Q0vw8QtI-ImpSHT86Clhh1ooHCUcxeHKt7vS8c6q6MJ2FhHvnTW4TfIxvh5OmnutexqwEi-96DmW75Ska1QzNlf9rmdL9PwsFNkInx5_Kjy2qkjHpGwd8t82gcwNHy6BMjgO5PyTvXqkJ5k2y1tCkofUac8QBgXMFPoU-DPhwW221NInbIeHD_zQ0UHYkP-7a64vPYJOo_zBSRl2JB6lPBFG5G1kA%3D%3D).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome.

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

**As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there.** After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own.

**Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first.**

I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.

**I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why** **[I'm hoping you'll pitch in a donation of $17.76 or more today.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)**

Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream.

**America deserves better. You deserve better.

It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves.** **[Will you join me today?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)**

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. **Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.**

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)
I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -**I need your help.**

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 in order to show the strength of our movement](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)** during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months.

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)**

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next Senator.**

We can revitalize the economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, and save America's future.

But in order to get the job done, it's going to take all hands on deck.

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)

Democrats at every level are outraising their GOP opponents. Schumer's allies have committed to spend whatever it takes to obliterate my campaign because if I win, it's **IMPOSSIBLE** for Democrats to keep their Senate majority.

**[That's why we need to fuel my campaign and show the Democrats in power that we have what it takes to WIN this fight. Will you join me today?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT-P3CAQxT8N7rBg4MAuKCJZllJcmitSWhywvkmMQfy5Vb595M1GShlpqqf3m9Gb9_11e7V44Ll_szEYrHUrj4mOchrx7C3QljZgICnTlMPGB29egE-3aQiGa2B6Ei-CDx_GeTZJqa2aJFOTAj3PEsDymxaOMaYHNNcepjlwxhUTI2deiZnf5slyBbMkkvXsbQsjnhV9qC6lnNOBDV0dU9mHw3y0lisRXwisBNYaXC9hvONZgh9digTW6FwqEd1Pmi2B9Uc_ftF3TDREiwf9BGqzJWItF1rw3IlYWumBgOotbjF47JGIJT_8T7WmXlwgYil1u_A_qrMxW9xPIpZnMr5d594xPeB_rM0RsXx9e6N_XzAU4_MdjwOr0kSy_QKuBEP7zx4-DfwOAAD__-d2jnM)**

I've lived the American Dream, and I can't sit back and watch it slip away for our kids. I need every freedom-loving American to help me reach the finish line. I promise I won't let you down.

Have a wonderful day!

clean_body: This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers Friend, As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me. Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer. This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else. After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me. True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission. As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step. In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome. As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there. After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own. Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first. I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first. I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream. America deserves better. You deserve better. It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves. I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority. I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -I need your help. during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future. Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months. I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next Senator. We can revitalize the economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, and save America's future. But in order to get the job done, it's going to take all hands on deck. Democrats at every level are outraising their GOP opponents. Schumer's allies have committed to spend whatever it takes to obliterate my campaign because if I win, it's IMPOSSIBLE for Democrats to keep their Senate majority. I've lived the American Dream, and I can't sit back and watch it slip away for our kids. I need every freedom-loving American to help me reach the finish line. I promise I won't let you down. # [J.R.R. Tolkien worked on the Oxford English Dictionary.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgibxz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgibxz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgibxz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| J ohn Ronald Reuel Tolkien is the grandfather of modern fantasy; his books _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings_ formed the foundation of the genre. But before the renowned writer and philologist crafted the world of Middle-earth, he spent some time working on another vital text, the Oxford English Dictionary. After being discharged from the British army due to illness, he got a job on staff at the OED from 1919 to 1920. During that time, he worked on words near the beginning of the “w” section, from “waggle” to “warlock.” (Tolkien might’ve been assigned this section because many “w” words, including “walnut,” “walrus,” and “wampum,” have difficult etymologies.) The famous author [once said that](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgibxz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) he “learned more in those two years than in any other equal period of my life.”
---
Although Tolkien’s tenure at the preeminent dictionary was a short one, his influence on linguistic tome continued for years to come. In 1969, when an OED editor reached out to Tolkien for comment on the addition of the word “hobbit” to the dictionary, the author responded with a definition twice as long as the original — the dictionary printed Tolkien’s version almost verbatim. The OED eventually added many more words from Tolkien’s famous high fantasy series — including gems such as “mithril,” “Orcish,” and “troll.”

## The first English dictionary included only 3,000 words.
The first dictionary of modern English, _A Table Alphabeticall,_ was published in 1604, just a handful of years after William Shakespeare’s _Romeo and Juliet._ Containing only about 3,000 words with simple definitions and no references or word origins, the dictionary was the sole work of Robert Cawdrey, an English schoolmaster and clergyman. Cawdrey set out to provide a text where readers “may more easily and better vnderstand many hard English wordes, which they shall heare or read in the Scriptures, Sermons, or elsewhere.” This dictionary was the first attempt to catalog words found in modern English, as opposed to Middle English, which preceded it. So many innovations occurred in the language in the 15th century — including pronunciation, spelling, grammar, and vocabulary — that it’s likely that Shakespeare would’ve had as tough a time reading Geoffrey Chaucer (who wrote _The Canterbury Tales_ in Middle English) as we do today. Although Cawdrey’s work was a valiant first attempt, many English dictionaries have been written since, and the latest Oxford English Dictionary contains more than 170,000 words in total.

| | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman.**[**Will you donate $35 or more right now to help fund this critical new lawsuit?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc2pnasevp23443e6f27jvjgd8t2c8cj20gqv0ao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctie6ob0s1h2bs)** **** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough _enough_ , Friend?The answer is **now.** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day **she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room.** The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. **Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave.** Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community.**[**Now you can see why I'm asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to help fund Julie's case.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsp6221r75mbu3ed3oltetil3hs6v2d1hci1frn8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctie6ob0s1h2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the _Center for American Liberty_ – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the _Center for American Liberty_ , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, Friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! **[**So can I count on you to donate $35 or more today to fund Julie's case and protect your own constitutional rights?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze9v130jpe7tpcm1og9bk0rmki6gbilnth3borag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctie6ob0s1h2bs)** My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. But it does mean we need to have the resources on hand for a dogfight. **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2nlf95o64d9e9qm0b8ll2daujgpc5q2mn6p02rg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0ctie6ob0s1h2bs)** Thank you for helping us fight back against the radical left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our constitutional rights.

name: Bob MacGuffie
subject: PRESS RELEASE - Himes Calls for Biden Bow-Out - Refusing to Acknowledge He Deceived Us
body:
Press Release
| | | |
---
| Press Release
---
---
| | In response to Jim Himes' deceptive call on Biden to "bow-out" of the presidential race, overnight I distributed the below Press Release to all press and electronic media covering the 4th District. If you seek a campaign of persistent-offence run against Mr. Himes, I would be honored with your vote in the August 13th Primary.
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: July 11, 2024 For more information: bob@bobmacforcongress.com 203-727-7798 Jim Himes Calls on Biden to Bow-Out - Refusing to Acknowledge that He Has Deceived Us About Biden's Condition for Years
Fairfield, CT - Today Jim Himes put out the following statement calling on President Biden to bow out of the race: "The 2024 election will define the future of American democracy, and we must put forth the strongest candidate possible to confront the threat posed by Trumps' promised MAGA authoritarianism," said Himes. "I no longer believe that is Joe Biden, and I hope that, as he has throughout a lifetime of public service, he will continue to put our nation first and, as he promised, make way for a new generation of leaders."
Bob MacGuffie, the endorsed Republican candidate for the Fourth Congressional District, issued the following statement in response to Mr. Himes' statement:
"As always with Mr. Himes it is all about politics and the political ramifications. Mr. Himes calls on President Biden to remove himself from the race because he knows Biden is destined to lose, and Himes is afraid he will be defeated as well. For the past couple years Himes has stood by Biden, assuring us Biden was fit, when every politico in DC and the rest of us in the 4th District knew Biden was mentally impaired. Throughout this period, Himes was content to have an impaired Biden in the presidency as long as his constituents didn't catch on. Mr. Himes has written the book on Gaslighting his congressional constituents.
"A responsible presidential cabinet would have passed around an affidavit calling for invoking the 25th Amendment long ago - and a responsible Representative Himes should have signed onto it then. It certainly should have been circulated two weeks ago. That is what's called for in the Constitution. But no - Mr. Himes continues to play politics, instead of adhering to his sworn oath of office. Jim Himes has a history of breaking either the letter or spirit of his oath of office over his 16-year rule."
MacGuffie called on the 4th District press to actually start covering Mr. Himes with a critical eye, and ask him the tough questions whenever he decides to reappear in the District. There is much to look at in his voting record, much to question, and much requiring explanation. MacGuffie is in this race, opposing Himes' policies and his abysmal votes, which would never be approved by a vote of his constituents. Mr. MacGuffie remains available to the press to offer comment and an alternative direction for the solid citizens of CT-4. # # #
---

| | Team,

One year ago today, I launched my campaign for Kansas’ 3rd District.

I’m a cancer physician, military officer, and legal immigrant. I’d never run for office, but I felt compelled to get involved and make a difference for the country that’s given me so much.

What a journey the last year has been.

_**[_**We started with an announcement video.**_](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/5f4cd91a380fadbcc3d6b838967d376c/43823)**_
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/d88ede8098858e93c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
Since then, we’ve attended hundreds of events, and met thousands of voters, in Kansas’ 3rd District.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/dbecfb3346879875c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
And we’ve earned support from proven conservative leaders like Elise Stefanik, Steve Scalise, and Mike Pompeo.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/b4140c4920b4f37fc3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
We have earned support and built momentum. NONE OF IT would be possible without YOU.

**And now, with less than four weeks left until the Republican primary on August 6th, I’m counting on your continued support to ensure we unite our party and win a big victory. **

__[**_That’s why I’m personally asking you, if you can, to donate any amount here and now._**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/fa89eef8eaad4735c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
_(And if you’ve already done so, forward this to someone who hasn’t.) _
---
[**DONATE NOW**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/9a4b49bc8d627a56c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
Our message is resonating in this district for one simple reason: Voters know that the American Dream is under attack, and they’re done waiting for career politicians to do something about it.

By all accounts, Sharice Davids is a nice person.

**But being a nice person doesn’t excuse enabling a border crisis, record inflation, a crime wave in the Kansas City Metro, and extremist ideas. **

**That’s the contrast I intend to make every single day in the general election, but I need your help to ensure we run through the tape on August 6th. **

[**So, what do you say? Are you ready to flip a House seat red and send a different kind of candidate to Congress?**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fe96138b06084bee3947229f28c3afba/d29a11562079c4bec3d6b838967d376c/43823)
I’m all-in, and I hope you’ll continue standing with me.

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...
---

---
To tomorrow's field of flowers. — No Dem Left Behind

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: Your 2023 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWtiWvYW8N

The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's
history and undermine our Constitution....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWtiWvYW8N

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379804:WtiWvYW8N:m:3:2532013465:00452F2F126F9B8C7C946DCA5723284D:r

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379804:WtiWvYW8N:m:3:2532013465:00452F2F126F9B8C7C946DCA5723284D:r

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379804:WtiWvYW8N:m:3:2532013465:00452F2F126F9B8C7C946DCA5723284D:r

Peter,
Two years ago, the U.S. Senate passed the CHIPS Act to end China’s domination of the semiconductor industry and keep more tech jobs in the U.S.
But there was a catch... the law contained language that requires companies to comply with ridiculous DEI regulations that have NOTHING to do with saving American jobs.
**That’s why Coach has introduced the CHIPS Improvement Act to remove this woke language from the CHIPS Act.**
This change will end costly “politically correct” H.R. practices, allowing American companies to better compete with Communist China.
_Make no mistake – this isn’t just about stopping jobs from going overseas. Allowing China to make the vast majority of our computer chips is a _major national security threat_._
Nearly every piece of technology we use today – cell phones, HVAC systems, cars, even appliances – relies on chips. And allowing China to control the chip supply chain gives them massive leverage over our country.
We must remove every possible obstacle for U.S. companies to compete with China, and that’s why passing this bill to improve the CHIPS Act is so crucial.
\- Team Tuberville

becoming “less likely” every day, historian Douglas Brinkley told

But these are the stakes of this November’s elections
#

Team -
If we don’t put in the work now to set our gun safety candidates up for success during this year’s elections, the consequences will be serious.
We could lose our gun safety Senate majority.
We could have two more years of MAGA Republicans holding the House majority.
Donald Trump could be president again.
We’re sorry to be so blunt, but these are the real stakes of November’s elections.
That’s why we’re working hard to support gun safety champions up and down the ballot. These are candidates who we know have the power to win their elections and will commit to doing the work in office to keep our communities safe from gun violence.
But our work to elect these folks is far from over. And that’s where you come in.

Remember the phrase, "You're on Mute" that was uttered so often during the COVID lock-downs? You would be talking, but no-one on the video call was able to hear you? We knew you were there, your lips were moving, but someone had to wave their hands and remind you to hit the "un-mute" button.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22f21d55-23c5-4242-ae76-6757cbd9055f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I am now waiving my hands and letting you know that your mute button may be turning on again soon, triggered by our own state officials. A combination of post-pandemic laws passed by the Minnesota legislative trifecta are now in place to allow government officials to [police your activities](https://substack.com/redirect/44543bc3-4c43-4cfe-a684-c622d35a54c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and to effectively mute your on-line activities.
@Bendasense Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5kYXNlbnNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.1KnVmNo3sLeRF8qNrKpuUupLkl1znUYTYxw3cZslQLA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=146251500)
The first _**mute-button**_ (Minn. Stat.[ § 609.771](https://substack.com/redirect/7412da96-6388-4e46-a72d-ccac61cc8d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) involves the restriction on the use of Deep Fake Technology to influence an election. As long ago as 2020, [tech experts](https://substack.com/redirect/36e11c9a-e00a-44f8-a0d8-aac57ae0f724?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were discussing how easy it was to create a deepfake meme through social media platforms. Just recently, YouTube has made it easier to make a takedown request for a post that uses a likeness without consent. In considering whether to takedown the video, YouTube has established a [complaint process](https://substack.com/redirect/ad194f66-516a-42ed-9087-b2cb0a85fc8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and has identified a variety of factors that will be considered.
Likewise, law enforcement officials in Minnesota (Attorney General, County Attorney, or City Attorney) are now empowered to determine whether a broadly defined set of technology representations are a "deep fake" and whether they were disseminated with the "intent to injure a candidate or influence the result of the election." This restriction kicks in on August 7th, or 90 days prior to the November 5th election. _Memers and bloggers beware, there is no defense or exception for[humor or entertainment value](https://substack.com/redirect/9de54185-c2b6-4e45-9485-e741dec66871?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _
Our own Secretary of State has a [handy guide](https://substack.com/redirect/37281064-3ebc-4986-aa9e-276b673b09f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) encouraging anyone to contact local law enforcement and seek court intervention if they feel that a deep fake is in play. Interestingly, the Secretary of State uses the phrase "widely shares" (rather than "disseminates"). This suggests to me that they intend to enforce this law not only against the person/entity that created the meme, but also anyone who posts, shares or even likes it. The social media police will certainly be watching your feeds carefully for every post, like and share that you click on.
I expect various efforts at silencing conservative social media influencers, either by the government, or on behalf of a candidate. Even the White House has resorted to [accusing](https://substack.com/redirect/3ec450ac-f997-4c58-86f9-78ee136624f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "right wing critics" of promoting "cheap fakes" against President Biden. With the current status of the election, expect depictions of President Biden in a memory care unit to be met with . . . resistance.
Secretary Simon, with the support of the DFL/dark money machine, can bird-dog in the complaints in the name of "Strengthening Democracy." Attorney General Ellingson, or other activist County Attorneys, will voice that they have "no choice" but to protect democracy and pursue enforcement. Even the threat of an investigative witch hunt is daunting, as the alleged perp can receive a sentence of up to a $10,000 fine and five years in prison.
Next up in the _**mute arsenal**_ is [Minn. Stat. § 211B.075](https://substack.com/redirect/05421db2-e694-4f0c-ab0b-26ddcb1ed7d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) entitled, "Intimidation and Interference with the Voting Process." There are three new violations established by this statute, Intimidation ("Subd. 1"), Deceptive Practices within 60 day of an election ("Subd. 2"), and Interference with registration or voting ("Subd. 3").
Under Subd. 1, the activities that are prohibited are the direct or indirect use of force, _**coercion**_ , violence, restraint, damage, harm, or loss, including loss of employment or economic reprisal... against a person with the intent to compel that person to.... vote for or against a candidate." I have highlighted the term _coercion_ as there is an extremely [fine line](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae25536-fd6f-46b4-b89f-0bbf0079b438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between policing political speech and protecting first amendment rights.
Imagine this charge against you under Subd. 1, "use of indirect coercion against a person with the intent to compel a vote for a candidate and against a different candidate." Simply the use of "indirect coercion" puts you in the cross-hairs. How people react to your words and actions will matter as the standard is whether your actions would cause a reasonable person to feel intimidated. I honestly think that uttering the words "election integrity" or "election transparency" in a public place would trigger enough angst that many in the room would claim to be intimidated. While I do not think that is reasonable, it is reality. Please note that establishing intent to intimidate is not required, "The Plaintiff does not need to show that the defendant intended to cause the victim to feel intimidated."
Under Subd. 2, you are in trouble if you "cause information to be transmitted" that intends to impede a person from exercising their right to vote. For the hand-vote advocates reading this post, this includes information regarding "the manner of holding an election." Likewise, Subd. 3 has a nice twist, you cannot impede someone who is registering voters or "aiding another person in casting a vote."
The final _**mute-trigger**_ ,[ Minn. Stat. §211B.076 ](https://substack.com/redirect/b8ad3ea4-bf71-4e8a-8a1b-626cc0b80cb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)criminalizes intimidation and interference with the job duties of election officials. Again, the bar for "intimidation" is not high - simply direct or indirect use or threat of coercion, or economic loss (including loss of employment) of an election official. Certainly, the narrative has been that demanding transparency in the administration of elections is a form of [intimidation](https://substack.com/redirect/f763a955-320d-4685-aa53-39c3381472b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [bullying](https://substack.com/redirect/cb5e09e4-d166-4594-9219-28276f40f7a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As I will explore in a future Substack, this narrative is set to ramp up in the months to come. This particular law feels a bit personal:(
Offering further intrigue, the last two mute-buttons discussed here (.075 and .076) contain a few unique provisions that should cause further concern. The first is titled, "Vicarious Liability; conspiracy." I wonder if this co-conspirator liability provision was added to leave open the possibility of broader legal actions against right-leaning organizations, even political parties. Couple this with the broad investigative powers imposed under Subd. 5(c) and we could see a flurry of lawfare activities in Minnesota. In short, [Minn. Stat. §8.31](https://substack.com/redirect/f27a0da1-f9bc-4ef3-8a64-15d16d0a1db2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) provides a summary civil law process to obtain information quickly, or face district court contempt proceedings.
Back to the original "you're on mute" quote of the year for 2020, according to [Forbes](https://substack.com/redirect/ce5fca82-b154-4e64-877d-ec0791e29102?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in December 2019 Zoom had 10 million users daily. This number quickly boomed to 300 million users as the lock-downs unfolded. Starting on May 15, 2020 the Minnesota Judicial Branch, like most courts in the United States moved swiftly to pivot to some type of remote proceedings. My world quickly transitioned to remote hearings and meetings with clients and adverse parties. It appears that this trend is here to stay, as most of my court appearances continue to be through Zoom. Whether this trend is positive, is still up for [debate](https://substack.com/redirect/22a036b3-d8bf-4c7a-b69a-8e7195627769?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Likewise, we must have a dialogue on whether our government should have their own mute buttons, with heavy investigate powers and civil and criminal penalties. As one [prominent politician ](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a42da5-481b-4286-97d8-2b7957a065ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)stated, "There is truth and there are lies...each of us has a duty... to defend the truth and defeat the lies." If those in power define the truth (or actively shield the truth), should they also be empowered to use the power of the state that they control to "defeat the lies?"
Matt Benda
Albert Lea Attorney and Community Advocate

The American people are watching.
On one side is Joe Biden, a leader who has created more than 15 million jobs, lowered health care and prescription drug costs, tackled the climate crisis, and approached his work with integrity and compassion.
On the other side is Donald Trump, who is clear he is only in this for himself. He has called for terminating the Constitution, vowed to be a dictator, and orchestrated an all-out assault on reproductive freedom.

[](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4c087d157c5749daa90608b4a53f364e&_e=iJbE_op2wsepoQnPScIWbRqf02P8yUE8K5hjvN188M5wCsh2ziqtUjOMaBl_ynQ2XPtoI04e3Vr9TVzl7ERdNi6vcU1XEBEFfdRQl1gCdQsUw-PnKJBTi5f2eIBc6CKhIMTYZtGc6yp1gYCa3BTZbGnuYXnP4Ie_KST3vclTNBK-NqNPhD_Xk_4Nj8sBOzUNcHe0O0ydK7Re_lUrTqDfFeNMfU6eHZm40LocL3uD1wmGEOQKcrDTsOvfPO1l7eGNRNEhmCkwJQ-dv8aPT8cPUA%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4c087d157c5749daa90608b4a53f364e&_e=iJbE_op2wsepoQnPScIWbRqf02P8yUE8K5hjvN188M5wCsh2ziqtUjOMaBl_ynQ2XPtoI04e3Vr9TVzl7ERdNi6vcU1XEBEFfdRQl1gCdQsUw-PnKJBTi5f2eIBc6CKhpz7vKB0Tuf0isH7YYhberw0a6A5AdmS-z_HpdD4jlhPcqN1sxDVxphpVMzoAUCdR8CAro36EvBdrPs5LCBb7heCeWwCpbHyn8tnI_BZXovvQzQOm-3h0JhkeKBZbThr-z4oycC83PBPkJbc4Q7fqyw%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4c087d157c5749daa90608b4a53f364e&_e=iJbE_op2wsepoQnPScIWbRqf02P8yUE8K5hjvN188M5wCsh2ziqtUjOMaBl_ynQ2XPtoI04e3Vr9TVzl7ERdNi6vcU1XEBEFfdRQl1gCdQsUw-PnKJBTi5f2eIBc6CKhc3SZDfb3pmAl-rbeBTGU9gX8CEmToH9fHoou-AFObydWeOO0FZjj9SlDxTC9Z0gQKxYFBf9U3XmRQjzyrp4J1sJ20cyk4pngbHhY-nolbigEn2g11us0pqliMvdeMHHEQV7-fsJrj7rCIudg1hfztA%3D%3D)

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Party Chair Race Overwhelms IL GOP Elites, SCC Appears as Confused as Joe Biden Going into Friday’s Meeting Without Any Plan (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
US President Joe Biden in April 2023. (Samuel Corum/Getty Images)

By Illinois Review
The Illinois Republican State Central Committee is the governing body of the IL GOP, but the state party chairman’s race is proving why Illinois Republicans remain in the super minority as the 17 members collectively look like Joe Biden trying to find his way off a stage – as mass confusion overwhelms party leadership – creating more questions than answers.

On Friday, the SCC is expected to meet during an afternoon Zoom call to elect a new chairman, but late on Thursday, it appeared as if an overwhelming majority of the SCC had yet to actually read the bylaws governing the process – creating a nightmare scenario for the party in the super minority. As the bylaws state, the SCC must replace a party chairman within 60 days, and the person selected must then serve for the remainder of the original term. However, many SCC members continue to float an “interim” chairman, while others discuss a permanent chair. But if any of those options are pursued, it would require changing the party’s bylaws.

On Wednesday evening, three candidates submitted their applications for party chairman: Aaron Del Mar, John Cabello and Kathy Salvi – but it’s Salvi – the former GOP nominee for U.S. Senate that’s creating the most buzz amongst grassroots circles. For the last two years, Salvi has defended outgoing chairman Don Tracy, co-hosted state party fundraisers with Tracy, and was endorsed by gubernatorial candidate Richard Irvin during the 2022 election cycle. Irvin was the state party’s favorite candidate – and Tracy’s too, although he won’t admit it – during the 2022 primary, but he lost in a landslide to the conservative grassroots-backed candidate by 43 points. And during the primary campaign, it was reported by WTTW’s Paris Schutz (https://news.wttw.com/2022/05/13/gop-gubernatorial-candidate-richard-irvin-called-donald-trump-idiot-bigoted-racist-text?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that in 2018, Irvin sent text messages calling Trump an “idiot” and a “bigoted racist.” Irvin also texted the friend, “I hate Trump
too!”
(Facebook)
Richard Irvin caught texting, “And I hate Trump too!” (WTTW News)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In October of 2022, just a month before the midterm election, Tracy and the IL GOP paid for a pro-choice mailer (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-violates-party-platform-pays-for-and-endorses-pro-choice-mailer-during-2022-midterm-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in support of failed candidate Greg Hart, who was running for DuPage County Board Chair. In the days leading up to the mailer, Hart’s wife Alex released a campaign video (https://patch.com/illinois/hinsdale/hinsdales-greg-hart-pro-choice?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) saying, “As DuPage chairman, Greg won’t change our laws supporting a woman’s right to choose, and he will always support women’s health.” And Hart remains a pro-choice “Never-Trumper” who continues to bash the wildly popular former president and presumptive Republican nominee for President on his social media accounts. In February, Tracy, Salvi and Hart co-hosted a gala together that oddly featured conservative pro-life U.S. Sen. John Kennedy from Louisiana.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/party-chair-race-overwhelms-il-gop-elites-scc-appears-as-confused-as-joe-biden-going-into-fridays-meeting-without-any-plan.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=96de2908d9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

When this publication highlighted the IL GOP leadership’s pro-choice views and expressed outrage that party money was being used to fund pro-choice mailers – the SCC was silent. And pro-life groups for the most part, remained silent on the issue as well.

On Wednesday, retiring State. Sen. Dan Caulkins, a conservative from Decatur and member of the Illinois Freedom Caucus, released a statement urging the delay of Tracy’s resignation as state party chair, arguing that, “My concern is that the selection process is rushed and ill timed.”

And he’s right.

| This is why I got into public service.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2988%2E35263%2EoG4qRC)
Peter — Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — _all because I had a pre-existing condition._ **That’s why I got into public service.** I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. Now, when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, _almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance._ So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — **including my Republican opponent who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.”** If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. That’s why I need your help to defeat him. [**Will you make a donation to my reelection campaign to defend our Democratic Senate majority? That’s the only way we’ll prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we’ve made expanding access to affordable health care.**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jul24.e1aXEk&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240712_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2988%2E35263%2EoG4qRC) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=tbe-em-jul24.owp_q2&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240712_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2988%2E35263%2EoG4qRC)

Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

#
Hey Derek, did you see this email from John last week?
👉It’s as clear as day: **Joe Biden is our guy.**
President Biden has repeatedly shown us what a true President looks like; and he — _for sure_ — looks a whole lot better than the convicted felon he is running against.

— Team Fetterman
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: John Fetterman
Date: Wed, July 3, 2024
Subject: F*ck that
To: Derek [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
ICYMI – Democrats started floating the idea of replacing President Biden after his debate against wannabe-dictator, Donald Trump, last week. 🤡

F*ck that.
**I refuse to join the Democratic vultures on Biden’s shoulder after the debate. No one knows more than me that a rough debate is not the sum total of the person and their record.**
Morning-after thermonuclear beat downs from my race post debate – and polling geniuses like 538 – predicted I'd lose by 2 points.
_And what happened?_
**👉 I was the only candidate to flip my seat AND win by a historic margin (+5).**
While Democrats are “freaking out” over one rough debate, Republicans are eager to campaign with a convicted felon without hesitation. In stark comparison, Biden:
* Has been a great President during terrible circumstances.
* Beat Trump decisively.
* Held every line.

I’ve been proud to campaign with Biden then + I’m proud to keep doing it now.
**[Derek,will you join me in standing with our President and help deliver him a much-needed second term in office by making a $5 contribution to his campaign right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240712?refcode=em20240712-9193&refcode2=9193_434096_SElEqS&akid=9193%2E434096%2ESElEqS)**

Here’s to stan-ing Biden and defeating Trump yet AGAIN. 🍨
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Here are five funny facts you might not know about the man known as the Railsplitter, Honest Abe, and, according to many historians, the nation’s greatest president.

body:
The Dems' dirty tricks won't stop us

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mf_7_9_update_resend&n=1)
---
Peter, Two days ago I sent an email that you may have missed. It had an important campaign update that I don't want to slip through the cracks. Please read: **The empire is pulling out all the stops to try to derail our campaign.** After Biden’s disastrous debate, millions of voters saw that the emperor has no clothes, and started looking for a campaign that shares their vision of a just and livable future. Nothing scares the political elites more - so it’s no surprise that they’re trying to knock out the leading anti-war, pro-worker, climate action campaign that’s already on the ballot for the majority of voters across the country. **Here’s the empire’s latest assault on democracy:** On Thursday June 27th, the FEC informed us that our campaign had qualified for primary matching funds. Then minutes later, **FEC told us the Treasury department will withhold our payments** to give priority to general election funding - _just in case_ the Democratic and Republican candidates decide they want it. **Let me explain why that’s so outrageous:**
* In 2022, there was over $420 million available for public funding in the Presidential Election Campaign, thanks to taxpayers who check the box on their income tax forms to contribute $3 to the cause.

* On March 22, 2024, **Congress raided the Presidential Election Campaign Fund** for $375m. This was well after we posted that “qualifying for public matching funds will be a game-changer for our campaign.” According to the FEC, there is now about $17 million left in the fund.

* **Secretary of the Treasury Janet Yellen - a Biden appointee - is now using this manufactured shortfall to withhold matching funds for qualified primary election candidates** to “prioritize” hypothetical general election candidates.

* The only candidates who could claim general election funds under the rules are the Democrat - Biden - and the Republican - Trump. But claiming public funds would limit these billion-dollar campaigns to spending the $17m in available public funding, and foregoing all private donations.

* In other words: **there’s no way in Hell that Biden or Trump will use public funds, and everyone knows it, but the Biden administration is using that “possibility” to withhold the matching funds we qualified for -** until two weeks after the Democratic nominating convention, _long after we need the money for our ballot drives._

**It’s a huge tribute to our campaign that the Democrats are declaring all-out war on democracy to stop us,** with their army of lawyers to sue us off the ballot, their job postings for campaign infiltrators and spies, and now their assault on public funding. They are terrified that we're on a roll to challenge empire, oligarchy, and genocide in this election. [**So I’m asking you from the bottom of my heart to give whatever you can today to keep our campaign going full speed ahead.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/matching?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mf_7_9_update_resend&n=2) The empire is doubling down, so we need to do the same to stay in the fight. This is their last-ditch effort to stop us. **If we can get through this together, we’ll be unstoppable.**
