body:
Sparknotes

| [](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBau9wzAEMRuabOKOOVYCim3I199J33TPXie445E76yzwt-qkYEhlQmqbmrfgy-UlovmzXPdPGsPpPJcHhNmu0msClx1auw4H3ZSY_GKdJC7MXrM-x4KORXTsjyizZGX4WmdXvgAyrB9GpRqGdG9wKXaYiTLFObx0TPtez1AxntJFskAewDjQqqdf0G_6f3QBp9f1UOo7wOIyHP7diPnYHxw%3D%3D)
---
Friends,

I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here - a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. There's so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkxCYVkSZ-iIAt2oFgavoDdFOG-VjyOAXznyiOAOOUD4-vgXbGRXQjL1xAw3D_XL8GmvaAck3I2F6PxbhiL8lzvrmQilR2RRBtOj8jNZKPM-ziDkCUdha0BmD8L78tcO5xz1sE4t3UUpJA-8GiEkOlCg%3D%3D)
This is a photo of me as a child. I grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. I grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbk1ooHsERThg7rOw7STuvedL1zVT7WOa0imW1FMNziZrG6J27xCAixB_kWqopE1mRV1RUnzhe7OhnGw8Omu7zmITRShYqs-00c-IUGacfjfr___xHW0dbypsIXnH1g7QZQVudTt2-3dS1y5lfhCPuCng%3D%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkZ7hXj1XX76TgLhGHqR68m43d9uYIF3sxD_ZTQOY2JhghclvZI3c7KIHRmI-ZL2oe1CISg_kRwDEMu_9pv2GbbJW4QbWPcMRKV1xGGJB1o4lpSgXPaH15s1IfHiQxl3mAYGhmYfdwwfWgNTpjKUphxA%3D%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkaJEAuWrRGZ8Eov_I7ueWJGcC3HkYDvWkP2Ecp1NU1lSv0_Gxw0scYeXuk83Wi8FsgxK_2YYr74gthPwPBG5u-CLiS2RhdQe2iY0aw_HENGmtyBkRzxZPAxodEYv8ijkHekuCZxhEXr7nb3yy_1aaTg%3D%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkMuEv0YG5YFJHdiHqDqm-BR1DuxBBvkel-QaYGNsnymWxZ7idsLoKWJaLDDgUVHyYTIxVaH9Lh7aT9ecsqKMtuOf6jrtQ_cWkeVsqiTYZ7_m51Mpp6anqLh5ibT7oxtmaNAGN1lWUHTPUnwG4jvB0-Q%3D%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now - a Senator in the United States Senate. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I've seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately - they fail themselves. It's an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots - my family - my hometown - are what got me here. The good and the bad.

[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkiZ72ASSOO3lXJq219nZiQIGwxTIw8IKChsxlf4X4L_Mst58x9JE5JAZd5LJpIE9WDCl5HbARfmgkieixVRTJLwqnXmNK1PiYHEvZDF-4SXolrO42PCKnvKDypLpKKT0jXrCK-P-vs9X08ri2X47RtA%3D%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs leaders who know what it's like to live in a left-behind community, not career politicians who do nothing for the American people.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of why I ran for U.S. Senate: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

[**_It's the honor of my life to serve you in the Senate, and I hope you can make a donation today. It would truly mean the world to me._**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRkDswhmV0lRXtg7ZXRDrPaH0ufMAVFOQs9ntUPW3_zbkcYE_5j61mem5vEr-j4pRKF6c52_3oX8gU7XjNjv9cKUu6tSC2MunW4QMtlDXkS8bqtv-rB9ZjTws65OSVpmQKhoxkoDDOq8NsjfB8FnaQgSHR_zrPvUsSIFgYgUc1El26Ovcg9ZMz5G6myRADM1wKQ%3D%3D)

| [**JOIN TEAM JD!**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=96d870ece18d4b438833327dc17acb91&_e=-UHi2BcmUKA-cfbrKdazLAwNTz_NMKRNgfEVTnviJctH5UMZla6WRbB97qAwZlpvEFZ-Cscf4y7sxqZrypMaNYGjzG7M1Uw-onDRgFh69I0vk-QdvOYsPOaP5Rhtq9iBHbA_uSRsaKfWjV_CfikSRvJXLy7-u908GcJCO-de9NV3sWHB8Qvz3_4NRPjlEXNc1tNuSZHVR3J99MexZoIzVuvUM93kOjGpeja2AUn4OK1M_jPLK6XeQ7HORQ-WMHCvR2DdRyIkzKQ4RyqpnucMnTjNSl6gM-qMYRo5nW3oyWbqeG6ThNhUHDPza8I1y0HI6o3BxlFYM87ekQhetP878Q%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for taking the time to read.

God bless,

JD Vance

**Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author.**
Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our
economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans.
Ohio needs JD Vance.

They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately - they fail themselves. It's an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots - my family - my hometown - are what got me here. The good and the bad. I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs leaders who know what it's like to live in a left-behind community, not career politicians who do nothing for the American people. I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of why I ran for U.S. Senate: leave no Ohioan behind. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read. God bless, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. This campaign hasn’t been your typical Congressional race, and we’re not planning to start being one here. Now, if this was a safe blue district where we were sure of victory come November, this type of thing would be fine for us. The problem is, VA-01 couldn’t be more different.
We’re up against a career politician in the pockets of industry, national MAGA donors, and dark-money PACs, and we can’t afford to miss even one fundraising deadline if we want to vote him out this November.

Friend, I want to personally thank you for always standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88759834/485046662/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5184-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ODYzMzk0Ni02MjQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4RXRBdr6zXqBRk2-CYUeCXVmDA6OKiz4QZXCDFWDeDE=)
Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act and is helping to stop the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**
But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York in 2022. **Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave this November — and they're directly targeting my seat.** I refuse to accept a single cent from corporate PACs, so I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to compete with their right-wing megadonors.
**[_Please, friend, you've stood by me so many times before, and I'm counting on you to have my back again. body:
Three straight emails without asking... please give this a look.

Folks,
The formula for winning is simple.
There are more Democrats than Republicans in this country. We just need to make sure they vote. If we do, we win. From President Biden to Congress, to our statehouses.
So I want to try something pretty ambitious this week, but I need your help to get it done.
As you've seen in a few previous emails, we're building a volunteer operation that can reach out and talk to voters in states across the country to do what I described above.
That effort started in earnest yesterday with a goal of contacting 22 million people we believe are good, solid Democratic voters in every state across the country.
We'll do it largely via text message conversations. There are already 1,000 people signed up to help. But talking to 22 million people... we need more.
So... I'm asking you to join this community. I'm asking you to do something that will help Democrats WIN this November. What do you say?
[**Use this link to say you're interested in joining our texting team, and to get started with our online community of others like you committed to make sure Democrats win this fall. We'll be in touch with more.**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/texter-2024/?source=em240712&t=1&akid=2118%2E4767699%2EOa1Opm)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/texter-2024/?source=em240712&t=2&akid=2118%2E4767699%2EOa1Opm)
Some of you have experience doing this. That's great. For others, it will be your first time. Also great.
But if you look at how many close races there were in the last election, and the tight polls in this one, these critical conversations can mean the difference between winning and losing.
We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now.
[**So please - take the first, small step: Use this link to sign-up and say you're interested in joining our texting team.**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/texter-2024/?source=em240712&t=3&akid=2118%2E4767699%2EOa1Opm)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/texter-2024/?source=em240712&t=4&akid=2118%2E4767699%2EOa1Opm)
22 million conversations. It'd be amazing. That's a lot of voters that will help tip key states and races.
Can't do this without you.
\- Gavin

—

# MAGA’s Project 2025 is an actual playbook to strip away vital rights and protections, and they’re already testing the waters
---
It’s been a long month already and it’s not stopping any time soon. Project 2025 lays out a 900 page plan to send our rights back over half a century. It’s a mammoth document that reveals how a MAGA presidency would very quickly act to consolidate power in the Oval Office, gutting our system of checks and balances, and undermining democracy. **MAGA’s Project 2025 takes extreme positions on issues that impact every facet of life, making it difficult to talk about without getting overwhelmed. BUT it’s important that we do talk about it and fight like hell to prevent it from being implemented!**
---
It allows for the mass firing and partisan replacement of federal employees, gets rid of unions and worker’s rights, wipes out environmental protections, eliminates access to many forms of reproductive healthcare, eliminates no-fault divorce, takes resources from public schools, and much more. Let’s start with how Project 2025 plans to control us through restricting healthcare access. The same powers that overturned Roe v. Henson calls out Project 2025 while Republicans are already putting the plan in action | | MAGA’s Project 2025 is an actual playbook to strip away vital rights and protections, and they’re already testing the waters It’s been a long month already and it’s not stopping any time soon. Project 2025 lays out a 900 page plan to send our rights back over half a century. It’s a mammoth document that reveals how a MAGA presidency would very quickly act to consolidate power in the Oval Office, gutting our system of checks and balances, and undermining democracy. MAGA’s Project 2025 takes extreme positions on issues that impact every facet of life, making it difficult to talk about without getting overwhelmed. BUT it’s important that we do talk about it and fight like hell to prevent it from being implemented! It allows for the mass firing and partisan replacement of federal employees, gets rid of unions and worker’s rights, wipes out environmental protections, eliminates access to many forms of reproductive healthcare, eliminates no-fault divorce, takes resources from public schools, and much more. Let’s start with how Project 2025 plans to control us through restricting healthcare access. The same powers that overturned Roe v. Wade and those that are outlawing abortion in states have spelled out their next steps. They detail how they will use a variety of means, including the archaic federal laws like the , to enact a national abortion, IVF and in vitro ban, restrict access to birth control and Plan B, and allow the CDC to increase abortion surveillance. There is no question that has nothing to do with medical safety, it’s only about controlling people’s bodies and determining whether and when they are able to have children. | In addition to reproductive healthcare, MAGA’s Project 2025 also aims to limit access to general healthcare for low-income individuals and families through cutting Medicaid funding. Medicare recipients will suffer as well. They are prioritizing repealing the Inflation Reduction Act, prescription drugs and allowing pharmaceutical companies to increase costs for as many as 18.5 million seniors and others who rely on Medicare. All of this is preventable if we all show up to vote in November! However, republicans are already testing the water, and getting some traction. Their anti-trans agenda is on full display as a policy right out of the Project 2025 playbook their families just passed out of the democratically controlled Senate Committee. It was slipped into a military funding bill and, unlike last year when democrats refused to pass anything that went against the bill’s intent, this year they voted it through. We all need to pay attention and see how our rights are being attacked and get loud about it! It’s much easier to strip our rights when people are unaware and stay quiet. subject: Why are Americans not alarmed by this?
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Fellow
American,

It's
nearly election season. We hear promises from both sides of the
aisle and commitments made to causes the American people rarely
agree on.

Surprisingly, however, 7 in 10 Americans agree on this one thing:

Across
our nation, unborn babies should be protected by at least the
point when they can feel pain. The latest science proves that
unborn babies can feel pain by as early as 15 weeks.

72% of
voters agree on this issue but the American people are still
being bombarded with lies and misinformation from Big Abortion
and its allies. These "pro-choice" organizations are committed to
using misleading information to manipulate women and destroy
innocent children for their own gain in this billion-dollar
industry.

In their
own materials, Planned Parenthood states abortion is "one of the
safest medical procedures performed in the United States" and
"abortion has over a 99 percent safety record."

But how
can this be true when a child's life is snatched from its
mother's womb because it's purposefully put to death? Who is
telling the American people the truth here?

What do
you think about this?

My team
and I would love to know your opinion about abortion in America.
We want to know your answers to questions like these:

Do you
believe life begins at conception?

Do you
believe abortion is harmful to women?

Do you
believe that unborn babies have a right to life?

We want
to hear what the American people think and invite you to take our
Abortion in America Survey so we know where you stand.

Take the
survey today and let us know if the majority of Americans are
being lied to by a deadly industry. Help us find the truth by
taking the survey today at the link below. We really want to get
10,000 responses from people just like you!

**The glaring loophole in current voting law is that it does not require documentary proof of citizenship for registration.** There is also no specific authority provided to state secretaries of state or local elections officials to access federal databases to confirm that there are no noncitizens on state voter rolls.

The SAVE Act is designed to cure these deficiencies. The legislation closes the loophole in federal law that enables foreign nationals — noncitizen resident aliens and illegal immigrants — to register to vote.

Imagine going out to take your dog for a walk on the National Mall and ending up in handcuffs, all because your dog was not on a leash. This scenario sounds absurd in America. “Ellison takes action to recover $58 million in Big Tobacco underpayments” – Kare 11
Peter,
As the People’s Lawyer, I am unwavering in my commitment to safeguarding the health and rights of Minnesotans. That’s why I’m taking action to hold Big Tobacco accountable for their deceptive practices.

Major tobacco companies currently owe Minnesota over $58 million. They've been underpaying us since 2019 by misrepresenting the terms of our state’s landmark 1998 settlement.

These companies misled the public for years about the dangers of tobacco. Now, emboldened by a significant tax cut, they are attempting to cheat Minnesotans out of the critical funds they’re owed for the damage they caused to our communities.

This is unacceptable, and I will not tolerate it.

This month, I filed a motion to not only reclaim these underpayments, but also to demand interest, civil penalties, and ensure that future payments are made in full.

Let me be 100% clear: This fight is about more than money. It's about holding corporations accountable and protecting our state's resources. It is about standing up for the rights and health of every Minnesotan. Thank you for powering my work and making it possible.

subject: What Donald Trump means for NATO

body:
Trump doesn’t even know what NATO is. Yes, he said that himself. He also said that he would have the United States limit intelligence sharing with our NATO allies. Trump invited Putin to do “whatever the hell he wants” to those allies. And Trump is meeting Putin’s ally, Hungarian dictator Viktor Orban, in Florida this week.
#
Derek,
NATO is the North American Treaty Organization, a voluntary security alliance of 30 nations across North America and Europe. This year marks 75 years since its creation.
After the most costly conflict in the history of the world, the United States and our allies joined together in a mutual agreement aimed at preventing future wars in Europe.
It is the most successful alliance in the history of the modern world, and the key is Article 5: an attack against one is an attack against all. That ironclad agreement has ensured safety and prosperity for the United States and our allies for the last 75 years.
But apparently, Trump doesn’t even know what NATO is. Yes, he said that himself. He also said that he would have the United States limit intelligence sharing with our NATO allies. Trump invited Putin to do “whatever the hell he wants” to those allies. And around the same time that President Biden was rallying our NATO allies and leading an hour long press conference, Trump met Putin’s ally, Hungarian dictator Viktor Orban, at Mar-a-Lago.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-july24.xPqeRJ&refcode=em240712-1-30&t=1&akid=25849%2E3013755%2E_Ksjx4)
Let’s be clear: Trump is pro-Putin and anti-NATO. Trump undermining NATO does not make us safer — it invites war. And emboldening Putin at the cost of NATO, encouraging his expansionist goals at re-establishing the Soviet bloc, will cause World War III.
But you wouldn’t even know it if you read the news. That has to change. VoteVets WILL change that — and we’ll do everything we can to prevent World War III by defeating Trump, once and for all.
We can’t do it alone, though. We need your help.

Joe Biden and Mary Peltola are Rolling Out the Red Carpet for China,
Russia

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, the Chinese Navy
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70084&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=62845> was spotted during a Coast Guard routine
patrol near the Aleutian islands in the Bering Sea, within our
exclusive economic zone. This spotting came late last week, according
to the Coast Guard - the week after Joe Biden's debate disaster on live
television - and just weeks after Russian warships
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70084&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=62846> were spotted in Havana, Cuba.

It is clear that Joe Biden's weak leadership enabled by Mary Peltola
and her Democrat colleagues are rolling out the red carpet for our
China, Russia, and our adversaries.

"First Russian warships in Havana, and now Chinese Naval vessels near
our Aleutian islands - I cannot understate how emboldened our
adversaries are by Joe Biden and his Democratic enablers like Mary
Peltola," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said in a statement. "Weakness
in the White House and in the People's House has led to our adversaries
believing they can test our waters, quite literally. America and the
world need peace through strength, not Joe Biden's weakness."

body:
Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA on July 23rd! RSVP today! | | | |
---
| | |
# July 23rd in San Mateo
---
|
---
| **[](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=54a473d703&e=c0babbc643)**

Please [join us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=1403ac3a88&e=c0babbc643) to learn how pets play a role in improving physical and mental well-being for kids, families and older adults at a special event my office is holding in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday, July 23, 12 Airport Blvd., San Mateo. According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=eff542c6be&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e43c7b277f&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=92fa079ed2&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=7ee1a3f298&e=c0babbc643)

name: Joe Pereles
subject: Relief for Hurricane Beryl victims
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Hurricane Beryl has recently caused massive disruption and damage throughout Texas, knocking out power for millions during some of the hottest times of the year.
In the storm system's wake, devastating floods and threats of severe tornadoes have followed, from Texas through the Midwest and even affecting parts of Vermont.
As an active member of the American Red Cross for over 38 years, it is heartbreaking to see the destruction of this powerful storm—but it is heartwarming to know that thousands of volunteers and courageous first responders will be answering the urgent call to help people in need. And they deserve nothing short of our full support.
This year, the campaign is keeping me from doing what I otherwise would have done: lacing up my boots and spending time with my fellow American Red Cross volunteers directly helping those who have lost homes, pets, cars and personal property, and in some truly tragic cases, loved ones or family members.
But that's why I wanted to take a moment to use my platform to highlight the work that the American Red Cross will be doing for victims of Hurricane Beryl. They are there, rebuilding lives and picking up the pieces after unthinkable disasters like this one.
You can go to www.redcross.org [http://www.redcross.org] to learn more about their disaster relief efforts, volunteer if you are able, or donate. You can also text the word REDCROSS to 90999 to make a donation. Please consider supporting the American Red Cross' rescue and recovery efforts to help those affected by Hurricane Beryl.
Thank you for doing everything you can to help others in need.
Yours in Service,
Joe Pereles

Friend,

I'd like to take a few minutes to tell you about my story.

My name is Mariannette Miller-Meeks and I have the pleasure of being the current Congresswoman of Iowa's 1st Congressional District. I am running for re-election to Congress because the people of Iowa deserve someone who will never quit fighting for them, their future, and the future of their American dream. As a Congresswoman, state senator, military veteran, and doctor, I have spent my entire life fighting to protect Iowa values.

Growing up, life wasn't always easy. My father, who was a Master Sergeant in the United States Air Force, often had to work multiple jobs to support our family. My mother, who only had a GED, had to work and raise our family as well. My parents taught me lessons of hard work, kindness, and love for country. I've taken what I learned from them throughout my entire life.

I always thought I wanted to be a teacher because I loved school and wanted to share my passion for learning with others. However, in 10th grade, my younger brother and I were severely burned in a kitchen fire. While at the hospital, I was treated by a physical therapist who went out of her way to make sure I got better. This woman's kindness and selflessness inspired me to become a doctor so I could help others.

I was the fourth of eight children with parents who did not have the means to pay for college. I left home at 16 and enrolled in community college. I later enlisted in the US Army at 18, going from Private to Lt. Colonel during my 24 years of service. I went into private medical practice in Ottumwa in 1997. My husband Curt and I have two grown children, Jonathon and Taylor. It's been one of my joyous achievements to raise two wonderful children with Curt.

In 2018, the voters of Senate District 41 elected me to fight for them in the Iowa State Senate. In 2020, I was elected to Congress by a six-vote margin, one of the closest races in United States election history. Then, in 2022, the voters of southeastern Iowa elected me again to fight for our values in the U.S. House of Representatives.

In Congress, I've been a conservative fighter for you. clean_body: | Friend, I'd like to take a few minutes to tell you about my story. My name is Mariannette Miller-Meeks and I have the pleasure of being the current Congresswoman of Iowa's 1st Congressional District. I am running for re-election to Congress because the people of Iowa deserve someone who will never quit fighting for them, their future, and the future of their American dream. As a Congresswoman, state senator, military veteran, and doctor, I have spent my entire life fighting to protect Iowa values. Growing up, life wasn't always easy. My father, who was a Master Sergeant in the United States Air Force, often had to work multiple jobs to support our family. My mother, who only had a GED, had to work and raise our family as well. My parents taught me lessons of hard work, kindness, and love for country. I've taken what I learned from them throughout my entire life. I always thought I wanted to be a teacher because I loved school and wanted to share my passion for learning with others. However, in 10th grade, my younger brother and I were severely burned in a kitchen fire. While at the hospital, I was treated by a physical therapist who went out of her way to make sure I got better. This woman's kindness and selflessness inspired me to become a doctor so I could help others. I was the fourth of eight children with parents who did not have the means to pay for college. I left home at 16 and enrolled in community college. I later enlisted in the US Army at 18, going from Private to Lt. Colonel during my 24 years of service. I went into private medical practice in Ottumwa in 1997. My husband Curt and I have two grown children, Jonathon and Taylor. It's been one of my joyous achievements to raise two wonderful children with Curt. In 2018, the voters of Senate District 41 elected me to fight for them in the Iowa State Senate. In 2020, I was elected to Congress by a six-vote margin, one of the closest races in United States election history. Then, in 2022, the voters of southeastern Iowa elected me again to fight for our values in the U.S. House of Representatives. In Congress, I've been a conservative fighter for you. I work tirelessly to lessen the economic burden on you and your family, secure our border, protect our streets, and provide every child with opportunities for quality education. While life hasn't always been easy for me, my Christian faith has helped guide every decision I make. It's been the honor of my lifetime to serve as the Congresswoman for the First Congressional of Iowa. | Thank you, and God Bless, Congresswoman Miller-Meeks Paid for by Miller-Meeks for Congress Miller-Meeks for Congress P.O. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Header.png]
It's an honor to receive another endorsement from the caucuses of the Michigan Democratic Party.
I am deeply grateful to the Anishinaabek Caucus for joining the MDP Progressive Caucus in backing my campaign in the primary.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
We're working to unite all the caucuses in the district and seeking upcoming mutually beneficial partnerships this August. These groups are full of eager volunteers who are willing to support us right now by providing volunteers and canvassers, but they require resources to do it effectively. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Your contributions this month will directly assist our caucus door-knockers with lodging, accommodation, travel, and voter outreach materials. We need you.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
Home to seven of Michigan's 12 federally recognized tribes, MI01 is surrounded by three Great Lakes, and it's critically important for your candidate to have the support of our party's Native community.
For my environmental policy, I adopted the "Seven Generations" philosophy. This Indigenous outlook says the decisions we make today should consider the impact they will leave on the next seven generations.
I join our tribes' long-term commitments to protecting land, sky, and water.
Throughout the campaign, I've been honored to sit on the Grandfather Drum and connect with elders about how a Congressman can help revitalize our Native communities and respect Indigenous ways of living.
It involves honoring treaties, self-determination, tribal sovereignty, and acknowledging our tribes' historical, traditional, and contemporary contributions to the Nation.
For the first part of my career, I served with the Indian Health Service in Navajo Nation. It was one of the greatest honors of my life. Today, I acknowledge Michigan's First District occupies the ancestral, traditional, and contemporary homeland of the Three Fires Confederacy, the Potawatomi, Odawa, and the Ojibwe.
It means a lot to me to have the support of the Anishinabeek Caucus. Together, united, we can help all citizens in Michigan's First District thrive.
Chi-Miigwech.
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

| | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. I know it's been a while since you last heard from me and there is a lot to catch you up on... Firstly, I want to reiterate from my post-primary email my deepest thanks to everyone who made the June 4th Primary extremely successful for Team Kean and Republicans across NJ07. With your help and hard work, Tom won his primary with _**over 78%**__ _ of the vote, and won every town in the District. You made this possible - the phone banks, door knocking, and direct voter contact paved the way for a successful election night. Together, we called over __**60,000**__ voters and knocked on __**tens of thousands**__ of doors across all six counties. Team Kean is looking forward to working with all local candidates in the coming months, to help ensure Republican victories up and down the ticket. We are guided by a simple message: __**ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM**__ Since the primary, our field team has been busy launching our general election plan, motivating our volunteer base, hosting phone banks, and door knocking! _**We are just under 4 months until ELECTION DAY**_ , and every day counts. We've also received some __**major endorsements**__ __,__ and just closed out Q2. (see below!) Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to!

| | **✅ Fire Grants and Safety Act Signed Into Law ✅**
---
| | On July 9th, Tom helped secure a __**major**__ win for firefighters and first responders. The _Fire Grant and Safety Act_ will provide a five-year reauthorization for the U.S. Fire Administration (USFA), the Assistance to Firefighter Grants (AFG) Program, and the Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response Grant (SAFER) Program. The bill was authored by Congressman Kean and signed into law by the President in the Oval Office. _“This bill will provide firefighters, as well as the communities they serve, the protection they both need. As a former volunteer firefighter and EMT, I know that we cannot play political games with the needs of our first responders.The Fire Grants and Safety Act passed the House with a 92% vote and with 88% in the Senate. We worked across the aisle and found common ground. We delivered big results that will change lives for the better.” _ _- **Tom Kean, Jr.**_

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. I know it's been a while since you last heard from me and there is a lot to catch you up on... Firstly, I want to reiterate from my post-primary email my deepest thanks to everyone who made the June 4th Primary extremely successful for Team Kean and Republicans across NJ07. With your help and hard work, Tom won his primary with over 78% of the vote, and won every town in the District. You made this possible - the phone banks, door knocking, and direct voter contact paved the way for a successful election night. Together, we called over 60,000 voters and knocked on tens of thousands of doors across all six counties. Team Kean is looking forward to working with all local candidates in the coming months, to help ensure Republican victories up and down the ticket. We are guided by a simple message: ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM Since the primary, our field team has been busy launching our general election plan, motivating our volunteer base, hosting phone banks, and door knocking! We are just under 4 months until ELECTION DAY , and every day counts. We've also received some major endorsements , and just closed out Q2. (see below!) Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | | | | | | ✅ Fire Grants and Safety Act Signed Into Law ✅ | | On July 9th, Tom helped secure a major win for firefighters and first responders. The Fire Grant and Safety Act will provide a five-year reauthorization for the U.S. Fire Administration (USFA), the Assistance to Firefighter Grants (AFG) Program, and the Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response Grant (SAFER) Program. The bill was authored by Congressman Kean and signed into law by the President in the Oval Office. “This bill will provide firefighters, as well as the communities they serve, the protection they both need. As a former volunteer firefighter and EMT, I know that we cannot play political games with the needs of our first responders.The Fire Grants and Safety Act passed the House with a 92% vote and with 88% in the Senate. We worked across the aisle and found common ground. We delivered big results that will change lives for the better.” - Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | Since the Primary, Tom and the team have been in the field regularly. Tell us if you’ve heard this one. 1\. Democrats nominate a liberal extremist. 2\. Republicans nominate a bold, outspoken conservative. 3\. The media covers for the liberal and smears the conservative. 4\. The voters see through the lies... and the Left freaks out. You already know that’s the story of the 2024 presidential campaign, but did you know the same thing is happening in this year’s **U.S. Senate race in Arizona**? Democrat Congressman **Ruben Gallego** is one of the angriest left-wing politicians in America. He supports abortion on demand, open borders, trans fanaticism, critical race theory, and every crackpot woke idea on record. He was even a member of the Progressive Caucus, which is the club for people who think Nancy Pelosi isn’t radical enough!

Now, Gallego is trying to hide from his past. And as usual, the media is helping him by running profiles about how he’s really a moderate, how he quit the Progressive Caucus, and how he talks up bipartisanship.

**_It’s all a scam._ _Gallego hasn’t changed._** His voting record from the conservative Heritage Action this year, after his supposed shift to the center, is ... _ZERO%!_

You know who else hasn’t changed? Conservative **Kari Lake**.

You know Kari as a principled, fighting truth-teller who is unafraid of the Left’s lies. She is the battle-tested conservative warrior with the guts and grit to put Arizona and America First again. **[**Please stand with Kari Lake today by making a contribution to her grassroots campaign!**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d1871acff20b4c80ae39107fa8245f6d&_e=m4PmTbG1L-NM1JJrZn6Pw5ZCkaySxF_UEYVGreBA6i4prkvbPdWSJPjB6q-5RfoPJXPND_PxbQ4xk8snEHeiCQ5-zQLxDNSU8jx4bf9Zr0cC-z1c24NVbh30aDl1y9VWPkVXW6FQbbUD10pRGrqTrLmcb1y-JAHqnLTUwvYZvEPm4b30TJwjqOW2RrC1IuoqLdIw6TWxTlMAnAYjLurTq2kWvmCOsa1xPaE7tS2Dtx7y-RVZyx408NwBOmiqNiypFV84FSBEwhzP0W7Opyvzwg%3D%3D)** _SCF will pay all processing fees so Kari can spend 100% of your donation defeating Ruben Gallego._

The shape of the race is now clear: Kari Lake is telling the truth while Ruben Gallego is hiding from it.

Friends,
I started the day today with my favorite mug:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240712_women_belong_in_the_house_link1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240712_women_belong_in_the_house_link1]
This is not just a slogan—it's a call to action.
Women make up over 50% of the electorate, yet we only hold about 27% of seats in Congress.
When we defeat Jim Jordan and flip this seat, I will be the first woman to represent Ohio's 4th Congressional District. Contribute to our campaign today and help us make history! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240712_women_belong_in_the_house_link1]
With reproductive freedoms and democracy on the line, we need more women elected to office up and down the ticket.
Democratic women, especially women of color, have always been the backbone of our party. For decades, we have helped to win majorities and drive progress.
We have the talent, experience, and tenacity to lead. It's time to break more glass ceilings and dismantle the outdated political structures that hold us back.
The truth is: Jim Jordan and the ULTRA-MAGA agenda aim to take women back 100 years to a time when we barely had any rights at all.
They want to strip away our reproductive freedoms, undermine our role in the workforce, and silence our voices in the halls of power. Some GOP elected officials have talked about taking away women’s right to vote!
This is a direct attack on the progress we have fought so hard to achieve.
Well, not on my watch! As the next generation of women trailblazers, I am running to defeat this dangerous agenda and represent all those who feel left behind, forgotten, or ignored by our government.

As a single mom, an entrepreneur, and someone who has faced and overcome financial challenges, I understand the struggles that many families face.
Jim Jordan talks about helping everyday Americans, but the truth is he votes against the people 97% of the time. He has been paid $3 million dollars to sit in Congress for 17 years and pass 0 bills.
That’s right - ZERO!
As your historic next representative, I will fight for policies that support our working families.
I’ll expand access to quality healthcare, including reproductive healthcare.
I’ll ensure our public schools are fully funded and create economic opportunities that benefit everyone.
And you know I’ll get it done, because that’s what I do. That’s what women do.
It's time for real leadership that prioritizes our needs over hyper-partisan MAGA chaos and corruption.
Together, we can create a world where women are not just participants but leaders. Let's ensure that our daughters see a Congress that truly represents them. Help us make this vision a reality and contribute to our campaign today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240712_women_belong_in_the_house_link2]

subject: Protecting Medicaid
body:
This is just one example.
#
**We need leaders who are both bold and build bridges at the same time.**
That’s how I was able to deliver on my bipartisan legislation, the Protect Medicaid Act of 2024, which recently passed both chambers of the Delaware General Assembly.
This legislation will unlock $175 million annually in new federal and state funding to **protect, enhance, and expand Medicaid** coverage for the nearly 33% of Delawareans who rely on this critical program. It’s the __largest__ ongoing investment in health care in the First State since the Affordable Care Act.
This is just _one example_ of how I roll up my sleeves to get big things done.
**And this is exactly the type of energy I’ll bring to Washington to meet the scope and scale of the challenges we face** — from affordable health care and housing to reproductive rights. But I need your help to get there.
[**So, if I’m the type of leader you want in Congress, please consider pitching in $5 to support my campaign today! Your donation will make a powerful difference in the homestretch of this race.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240712-1?refcode=em20240712-1-800&amount=5&refcode2=800_21716_XnvV95&akid=800%2E21716%2EXnvV95)

It’s the largest ongoing investment in health care in the First State since the Affordable Care Act. This is just one example of how I roll up my sleeves to get big things done. And this is exactly the type of energy I’ll bring to Washington to meet the scope and scale of the challenges we face — from affordable health care and housing to reproductive rights. But I need your help to get there. Thank you! Sarah McBride

Peter, Amid the two weeks of breathless coverage of President Biden’s debate performance and praise for Donald Trump’s new “disciplined” campaign by the legacy media, you may have missed the news on Trump’s recent unhinged and barely coherent rally in South Florida. During the rally, Trump played the hits, spouting his usual litany of lies, hate, and grievances. Notably, however, the rally was full of slip-ups and incoherent statements. Here’s what we mean: Trump repeatedly slurred his words and, in one particularly incomprehensible line, promised mothers would never see their children “overdosing and hosplee (?)” (whatever that means). He warned that if you go and visit Washington D.C. to see the Jefferson Memorial or the Washington Monument, you will be “shot, mugged and raped” despite the fact that the violent crime rate has dropped there by 30% in the last year. He claimed his son Don Jr. is married when he’s actually just engaged. So, it’s fair to ask, where is the media outrage? Where are the calls for Trump to suspend his campaign? = While we’ve spent the last two weeks (and counting) dealing with a barrage of questions from the media to the Democratic party about Biden’s ability to run in 2024, the media has spun a very different story about Trump. Apparently, he’s running a “disciplined” campaign, completely different from the Trump we’ve known for nearly a decade. 🤨 Not only has Trump had his fair share of stumbles and missteps – which the media has refused to cover – he’s still up to the fascistic antics that make him unfit for the presidency. Since the debate, he’s called for his political enemies to be jailed or tried in televised military tribunals. He lied about the crime rates in D.C., called the U.S. a “third world country,” and then claimed free speech was no longer allowed in the U.S. The legacy media might be afraid to call out Trump, but COURIER isn’t. * Project 2025 is Republicans’ detailed and coordinated plan to attack our rights, freedoms, values, and democratic institutions. It’s a direct and explicit threat to our democracy and our country.

Friend,

We know a second Trump presidency would be disastrous. However, a new plan backed by the conservative Heritage Foundation, much of which is in line with the official GOP platform, could spell far worse for hardworking Americans.

Project 2025 [https://www.mediamatters.org/heritage-foundation/guide-project-2025-extreme-right-wing-agenda-next-republican-administration] , also known as the Presidential Transition Project, is a roadmap for Trump to change American society as we know it. The 900-page plan proposes chilling policy changes that would crush working families.

https://act.rokhanna.com/a/trump-project-2025-petition?contactdata=LA6FIBdGpDFC5TAYKc812AfVy1OVuseTRx/qaTkVBI2NeCyXBsxKW2fPGGZI3LDNa/suTKEURBhokQr+7mULgSkpCG5t3Vh4oAaqFbNqvxUUUhCxXlAb5ZtvgeIHFeozgNN+KzMeJiG8HpiGFPMHAQ== [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/trump-project-2025-petition?contactdata=LA6FIBdGpDFC5TAYKc812AfVy1OVuseTRx/qaTkVBI2NeCyXBsxKW2fPGGZI3LDNa/suTKEURBhokQr+7mULgSkpCG5t3Vh4oAaqFbNqvxUUUhCxXlAb5ZtvgeIHFeozgNN+KzMeJiG8HpiGFPMHAQ==]

Trump’s Project 2025 is a radical agenda to remake America. It includes:

* Banning mifepristone, a medication used in almost two-thirds of all abortions;
* Halting efforts to reduce prescription drug prices;
* Dismantling workers’ rights to unionize and gutting the National Labor Relations Board;
* Restricting access to food assistance and affordable early childhood education;
* Permitting the mass arrest and deportation of undocumented immigrants; and
* Reversing the progress in the fight against the climate crisis, including fossil fuel regulations and clean energy programs.

And that barely begins to describe what Trump plans to do.

We can’t allow Project 2025 to be our future. Will you join me and pledge to help us beat Donald Trump and Project 2025 in November? Now more than ever, we need to elect leaders who can unite people, not push them apart. We must do all we can to continue our push for progress.

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,

body:
I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but...
Friend, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip. **
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.
So, please:

clean_body: I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but... Friend, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift. And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point. But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump. And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really. She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip. One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers. If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report. subject: If Josh Hawley had his way, the government wouldn't let me be a father

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, last month, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF
and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee
access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55844?refcode=em20240712-5992&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=5992%2E614464%2E3o0U7s ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

contribution instantly:

wanting to tell you a bit more about Lucas Kunce and why I know he can
defeat Josh Hawley — but only if he has your help. Lucas is the Marine

He’s built a record-breaking movement and is drawing huge crowds at events

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County Republican Party News (July 11, 2024)
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

You are invited to our next Republican Party meeting.

If you lament the direction our nation is going, there is no more
grassroots engagement opportunity than your County Republican Party to
begin to turn the tide.

We meet on the 3rd Tuesday of each month (except December), so our next
meeting is next Tuesday (July 16th). Meetings start at 6:00 pm at Calvary
United Baptist Church, 9480 County Road 25A, Sidney. Our meetings are in
the fellowship hall in the back of the church and are open to all Shelby
County Republicans and like-minded conservatives.

Topics turn toward election preparation as each election approaches, and
we’re less than 3 months away from “early" voting in a pretty consequential
Presidential Election. Conservative counties like ours must turn out every
possible vote to help offset the liberal votes in liberal population
centers in our state. Getting out the conservative vote will be our prime
objective between now and November 5th.

Many voters will tune out the election until just after Labor Day. We,
however, have a responsibility to lay the groundwork now so our voters have
what they need come election time and actually go to the polls and vote.
Our opposition will try hard to keep conservatives away from the polls, to
include trying to make us think we’ve got it won and there’s no need to go
vote.

Therefore, we will be discussing ways we intend to Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV)
during early voting in October and on Election Day in November. Please
come to our meetings to stay informed, to provide input, and possibly to
find a meaningful way to help ensure we win this election in November. A
sampling of things we will be discussing in the next few months are:

Appointing a replacement to fill the remainder of a retiring county
commissioner's term
Plans for the Republican Tent at the Fair (July 21-27)
Republican Slate Card mailing and distribution
Yard Sign distribution
Trump Merchandise availability
Plans for the Republican Tent on the Square on Saturday mornings (Sep 7 -
Nov 2).
Voter Registration
Lake Loramie Trump Boat Parade (Flotilla) on Labor Day Weekend
Election Integrity and the role Republican Poll Workers play
The importance of “down-ticket” races
Guest speakers/events
Party contributions to candidates
...and much more

Attached is a flier for an important event in Troy at the end of this
month. The Ohio Supreme Court hangs in the balance this fall. If we lose
just one of the three Ohio Supreme Court races, the court flips to a
liberal majority. Liberal courts are notorious for interpreting laws the
way liberals “want them to be written” instead of the way they are
“actually” written. We must maintain a conservative majority if we want
our laws to mean anything at all. Your local party has already donated
$3,000 to each of these three candidates and we will do all we can to
ensure they win. The importance of these three races cannot be overstated,
and this event provides us with an opportunity to support one of these
justices and to hear about the battle for Ohio’s highest court.

Also attached is your current Republican Central Committee roster. The
term “Central Committee” is simply the language Ohio Law uses to identify
the formally recognized leadership team of each county party. You’ll
notice that many of these elected positions are vacant. This is a
nationwide problem and it is, quite frankly, why our state and national
Republican Party might not be performing as we rural conservatives would
want them to. The “roots” of the state and national Republican Party have
been neglected for far too long, so we should expect to reap what we sow.
The Shelby County Republican Party has gone through a significant positive
transformation in the last decade, but there is still much work to be
done. If serving on the local conservative Republican Party leadership
team interests you, we’d love to talk to you. Please feel free to contact
any one of us currently serving on the team to learn more. We can appoint
qualified candidates to fill vacant positions.

Cheers...Dan Cecil
Chairman
(937) 206-2970
cecilda.usaf@gmail.com

Your contribution, regardless of its size, is crucial in our fight against these deeply misguided healthcare policies.
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
Rep. Jack Bergman has long-celebrated bad healthcare policies we find in Project 2025, but Dr. Bob Lorinser is sounding the alarm on its disastrous impact on everyday Americans.
Medicare and Medicaid : Project 2025's plan to convert Medicaid to block grants and shift Medicare to a premium support system will significantly increase costs and reduce coverage for seniors and low-income families. Dr. Bob warns that this will leave our most vulnerable without the care they need.
Privatization : Bergman supports privatizing healthcare, which would widen the gap between the rich and poor. Dr. Bob stresses that healthcare should not be a luxury, and privatization would make it harder for low-income families to access essential services.
Drug Pricing : Project 2025's market-based pricing could dramatically increase medication costs. Dr. Bob fights for fair pricing to ensure no American has to choose between their health and finances.
ACA Repeal : Bergman's attempt at repealing the Affordable Care Act directly threatens millions who could lose their coverage. Dr. Bob is committed to defending those with pre-existing conditions and improving, not dismantling, the ACA.
Dr. Bob Lorinser stands firm against Project 2025, advocating for a healthcare system that works for everyone, not just the wealthy. This dangerous plan will hurt millions, and Dr. Bob is ready to fight for the health and well-being of all Americans.
Your contributions help us spread the word and encourage voters to cast their ballots on or before August 6th.
Lives may depend on it.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Hey Peter -- I know you have better things to do than read these emails, but I hope you’ll give me just a minute of your time.
I’m in the fight of my life, and the odds against our campaign keep stacking up.
I’m running against an **ultra-wealthy, handpicked opponent** who can write his campaign million-dollar checks at the drop of a hat.
Experts have ranked Montana’s Senate race a **toss-up** , and with **recent polls locked in a tie** , it’s anyone’s to win.
And a super PAC just made a **NEW seven-figure ad buy** in Montana to help my out-of-stater opponent win.
**Look, the sky won’t fall if you don’t chip in -- and I’ll never trick you into donating. That’s not how I do things. But I will tell you the truth: We’re facing a serious decline in fundraising and I need you to give today to help us catch up.**
[**So, Peter: Can you make a split donation of $5 to Bob Casey and my campaign? We’re powered by folks like you—and that’s the only way we’ll overcome these odds and win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240712-2?refcode=em20240712-2&refcode2=3546_552475_-S0pQZ&akid=3546%2E552475%2E-S0pQZ)

Thank you,
Jon
