I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMSUyQ45dgGTz0PfC4lUyYEE-CF1URVN5rneSxLC6z4p1nbbDfxYpAPrlXECTj3qrUr1bnuG3ETnHDU37FQHv6vrxjmz5BFk3FYnF4kuZTfrobhnWtYzraFNMyhOS27L5zWnBlVrmKxSr0nAg9KLcQwN5VtbqSbn2Uy6IHsYKzPsq-)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMST9yb_OG-Az2YhRtkMVJj3MTx_v6ODgPLdqcRZbO8g6EJRn8HgCwbCGeEQIQ46FpuFgHd8ACqJkMnj0cpTmVOINh_oyv404qxxVDiLGU0UxJxpql2oxNs8giwymmed0-A2TT4OpLLwqWxR0bZAY_boOf8yLiwcVrQp6-n1QUAcEX)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMSdTBDZDXLV2kF5ZAijzwmDO5T3RVJQOJJAyWdVygzYj_dZqm1NTxssTv0c764Uzkx-iQFYsILjVcP6DBGAvF2An9bHf4wJhFJOREMAKLbvEmuzPZea2YIz5ysZ9YQGbiNAKWHxfH8JtzOqXQ12tL7M3DZT60sJ21BhWGLosCswD8)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMSZwQIyL335TMMCrMRbTDl0NfJ9Nx1Fz11QYLrgNsS3bCCurQATePcfhAWyPggp9INTPjnH08Cz75a2bSvYdG5S2PeAM6C4TnP46bb3QBwGqtpZcibgm7lbn3HZD03wF4-GC-S8Y7XEH9-Pn3YCeitGcS4rwisjFGFQDC_lcGbqbV)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMSdiVk9NSa_Yso2KX2spSmCNqnMgQRjff12Lmzq4xvcZwSfE1YDAWlbrm_wmD2B98uuqHjqYYAthRbWh8mrz-Iixf4QLjjQtQVSGAKQCZLNX-Am4gkg1i_kegGARHnOQAKeydsSIF1Hmrw9v12f-1FkbhsaACJu9b0Nuk-xMlu-40)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4c3b032ef38340e8ad11ab39363c3892&_e=Uf5Q6Kesk02jFXb0ecYFzv8sasQLEAsX6B74UiBbLIt4ajePKBfoYqqLfJJGZNPZgXJUubtH7iDmuo2nCLR1jtQCY6EnYLOkK66FyyO31B_mYQh1QU5aUL-oIGuA19VHsVYKEWQQZ8Cnu5AZpvmIB3CYh4vInU3OlFhwMH8q1KvsbljVMrFZHyUJ1c9dYdqVRcxt8HxvkLGlLMe7_uqMSXUVo_jA-7SRvfpCQvBzD70SCMwvZvh3Ib1Q0Vinyldht1-VCUM6pH8tht9KoElK4HBcm_PwMfgkGMdUSUO28eablvqPaMx2xyBrXexTYdL350mk9HpR1_oyIoINnKBvPWkStoKov3Ek7BhAEqc0xtU6XDp_PWLDbeDH3BHQn4B7)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/12/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi there!
Have a great summer weekend -- stay cool in those [extreme temps](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) out there, friends! This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, July 12, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Ganahl: Is Colorado Gov. Jared Polis's emergency declaration a public health measure or political maneuver for the White House?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
___When Gov. Jared Polis declared a state of disaster in Colorado because of a surge in Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), known commonly as bird flu, it ignited both a mix of public concern and political debate._ __
_The move is, in the legal term prima facie "on appearance", aimed at mitigating the spread of the virus, but critics argue that it may also serve as a calculated political strategy. The timing is suspect. Jared Polis would like to be president if Joe Biden drops out of the race._ __
_Bird flu is a highly infectious disease that affects both wild and domestic birds. Colorado reported its first cases in wild birds in March 2022, followed by detections in domestic poultry in April. Since then, the virus has been identified in 17 counties across the state. Colorado has 64 counties, so this is more than a quarter of the state 's counties, if you are keeping score at home._
____
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[As wolves have ravaged livestock,'Born To Be Wild' plates devoted to them has raised over $300,000](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [OUT THERE COLORADO ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's 'Born To Be Wild' license plates raised $312,800 in six months to fund non-lethal conflict mitigation between wolves and livestock.
* Funds support methods like repellent lights, fladry fences, and trained guardian dogs to prevent livestock predation.
* The plates symbolize Colorado's commitment to humane wildlife management, allowing residents to support these efforts financially.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Aurora may get tougher on penalties for motorists without license plates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Aurora City Council Member Stephanie Hancock proposes stricter enforcement on vehicles with expired or missing plates, including possible towing and impounding.
* Mayor Mike Coffman supports the initiative, emphasizing fairness for those who comply with vehicle registration laws.
* Despite increased police enforcement and issuing over 75 summons in a week, many drivers continue to drive unregistered vehicles due to forgetfulness or financial constraints

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Classroom'churn' has negative effect on third grade reading scores, study finds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CHALKBEAT COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver Public Schools implemented a new reading curriculum, improving kindergarten through third-grade reading levels, though they remain below pre-pandemic figures.
* A significant percentage of students are still reading well below grade level, leading to the introduction of a new teacher-led intervention program, Really Great Reading.
* Changes include a new approach to literacy assessments and expanded teacher training to better address individual student needs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Arapahoe County sheriff's office under review for diverting $380k to sheriff's non-profit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Arapahoe County Board of Commissioners assumed control of the Sheriff's Office finances after it overspent by nearly $1 million and improperly transferred $380,000 to a non-profit, violating state laws.
* The non-profit, the Arapahoe County Sheriffs Office Foundation, funded by taxpayer dollars, lacked complete financial disclosures despite receiving significant public funds.
* New oversight measures were imposed on the Sheriff's Office, including monthly and quarterly financial reviews and mandatory training for staff, to prevent future financial mismanagement.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Harless: Democrats' lies about Project 2025 is fearmongering campaign aimed at smearing Trump, helping Biden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_Democrat officials have launched a disinformation campaign about the Heritage Foundation 's Project 2025, misattributing policies nowhere to be found in the project and falsely linking them to former President Donald Trump._
_The project is a policy roadmap for a future Republican administration created by the Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank, and outlined in a nearly 1,000-page documentEditSign highlighting long-held conservative priorities. The left 's fearmongering campaign comes amidst panic in the Democratic Party, which has fractured over Biden's cognitive decline and abysmal election polling._
_"[Project 2025] is a dangerous takeover by Trump and his allies to pass his extreme MAGA agenda," Biden recently said on X, including a video that claims the project "would allow employers to stop paying overtime for millions" and "enact a national abortion ban."_
_The claims are massive distortions of the project 's actual policies._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Ashbaugh: How a Latino Democrat and a Black Republican opened a white, middle-aged woman's eyes ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY ERIN ASHBAUGH | COMMENTARY | JULY 10** _ "I'm a Republican." he said. "Ohhhh, I never pegged you to be that. I don't think we can be friends anymore," I laughed, only half-kidding. I was what one would consider a "Far Left" Democrat living in Boulder, CO when I said this, and Republicans were "the enemy."_
**_[Dion: Colorado Republicans, it's time to unite and fight ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY JAMESON DION | COMMENTARY | JULY 9** _In Colorado, Republican Party politics has been defined in recent years by losses, infighting and a steady decline in the percentage of Colorado voters that affiliate with the party._
**[Tooker: Why am I opposed to the 400,000-acre proposed Dolores River National Monument?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY AIMEE TOOKER | STATE | JULY 9** _The west end of Montrose County is one of four Tier One coal-affected communities in Colorado. The effect of the closure of Western Fuels coal mine in 2018 and Tri-State Generation and Transmission 's coal plant in 2019 (two years ahead of schedule) had an obvious detrimental effect on our local businesses._

Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com?subject=Contributor%20Interest%20\(via%20Mountain%20Minute\))) or send us a message on social media to chat!
|

**🧐 DID YOU KNOW?** **Warren G. Harding 's dog**, Laddie Boy, **had his own seat at Cabinet meetings,** making him quite the presidential pet and the White House's first celebrity dog.
|

---
| |
Dear Friend of Knowledge, Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life? Often, I find myself in that position as well. It's part of the human condition to be faced with difficult situations, choices, and people. We teach at Hillsdale College that we must carefully consider concepts such as morality, ethics, happiness, courage, character, and justice when we face difficult questions. In the _Nicomachean Ethics_ --the first book written on how best to live--Aristotle argues that human happiness chiefly depends upon a person's character, which is formed by making good choices. But good choices don't come naturally. That's why every student at Hillsdale studies Aristotle. In fact, understanding Aristotle is so important to living a good life that we've produced our online course, **" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ : How to Lead a Good Life." **
---
| | And now you can own the course on DVD, along with a special Hillsdale College edition of Aristotle's _Nicomachean Ethics_ , for personal study. You'll not only study what Aristotle says about the good life with Hillsdale College President Larry P. Arnn, but you will also explore ways to put this knowledge to work.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=d27b03aec233401fb0188f77a38961a8&_e=PAZLsmBNuNqImb9y1df9RmVO1RdCYy6PJ7nm3sHDo2JWRvVU4rfwS0sUdneclbyg_W3ZEEok7qdFCmbuPvdgXh84rGLOKGtWeTpfj2_G6K3ZY9we7dUEKQ6VZjDx1wPytImsNXmv4YALPs11KHlnXb66SC8g9zjh4bizmJIIhWm3hid8MZtvRiX54XAguFLvkmWrvkfug_qCVYnOOcRmRhFdyjVIHAAj7wLC5p-CyeUN_eQT2zWCseUds56b1wbmHWm_EE5QQfa7TLoLIy-mh78lDhm987I5FSH_nR1VZYzLVCHWlKuJ21JwEKgmyucVlS7ZEqUSVx7Ze9BvpV8cxOe7yu4TcVaTsbmHwbmTJFtyi2QoEBXOgQWSRrsM_fb8WE6_Xkkg6SiWdr0elKeQpQ%3D%3D)
---
| | The DVD gives you a seat at the table in a seminar-style class like those here on campus, and you'll read from the same book the students are in the course. In addition to the topics I've already mentioned, the course focuses on subjects including:
* Aristotle's _Politics_ and the Nature of Man
* Deliberation and Choice
* Practical Judgment

Letting [10+ million](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7cf8c39395c440a69665fbed0821e7e2&_e=IGzHdPjrKMPn5agav9fONxG3AXuY5dv2st6mon4v0fkId3SHXY3HU0EbhGu0-SJEQj0HOwdC1GdeIpSdOxCLt0BpS-hAox3kqU1mB0MAd-WIuBf4nfUgvsV9BLb6ohF9eUvJyD4evja7UHQosMxzXKBbeyUsbcQ-OKwJuwxKNUVreAVjYczYD0QEuE7kX1qD1jo_OKqdXeG0GicNgE1-fgoNFR_S3ANE5aTtSnn3yehYDf6Gm-6HVDm3OrA9aCTz8DB7Eok6n0tqWNxr2BvgWGBawQmbMtG-j1GQlDyWPg0%3D) illegals into our country and allowing even one of them to vote is treasonous. What a concept, right? But of course, 198 Democrats voted against this thing, claiming it’s all a conspiracy to prevent black and brown people from voting. They say we’re to require a dadgum ID at the polls, but the only racists in this equation are Democrats who think people of color are apparently too inept to go get an ID. The hard, cruel fact is this: If you’re not an American, you don’t get to choose our nation’s leaders. Democrats don’t like this bill because it would make it harder for them to cheat. They want to use illegal aliens to boost their numbers—and it’s not right. To no one’s surprise, President Biden has already to veto the bill, and we can’t let that happen. We need to protect Americans’ rights, especially when you consider this is a no-brainer among the people. Recent polling suggests of people support the requirement of a government-issued photo identification before voting. The Left likes to talk a big game about democracy, but there’s nothing more democratic than upholding the integrity of U.S. elections. Let’s stand strong and ensure that our elections remain fair, transparent, and secure. We owe it to every American to safeguard their vote and their voice. | | | | | GOTV Tennessee ☑️ | | | | Speaking of voting, it’s an important day in the great state of Tennessee! Early voting kicks off today and will be available through Saturday, July 27. I can’t stress enough how important it is to head to the polls early. Whether it’s a thunderstorm or traffic back-up on the highway, anything can happen on Election Day—so it’s best to get the job done early. For a list of early voting locations and times, head to and find your . As we continue full steam ahead on the campaign trail, I’ve been criss-crossing the district for events and door knocking. It’s an absolute pleasure to meet so many of you in person, and I am grateful for every opportunity to hear about the issues that get you fired up. I take all of it with me back to Washington as I continue to fight for you and the things that matter. | | | | | Just For Fun 🎉 | | → Never too late 🎓 () → Light up the night ⚡ ()→ Little angler, big catch 🐟 () | | | | | Product Of The Month 🛍 | | | | | | | Please chip in today to help us oust radical Democrats and put a check on the Biden-Harris agenda. | | Stay in Touch 👇 | | | | ---|---|---|--- Paid for by Burchett for Congress

body:
logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/Kleinmann_InterimBrand_Primary_DropShadowSmall.png]
Hi Peter, [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/pics%20of%20matt/448398405_17851867680215403_8481618424360323414_n.jpg]
I hope you're enjoying the month of July as much as I am! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/pics%20of%20matt/450937098_17855480718215403_5080494904269597223_n.jpg]
I've had a great time traveling, meeting, and listening with voters across our district. Just in the last two days I've met with youth and nonprofit visionaries in Kansas City, leaders advancing women in political leadership in Topeka, and local Democratic leaders in Leavenworth. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/pics%20of%20matt/449758714_17854799364215403_29177135953713731_n.jpg]
It's been a privilege to meet new friends and reconnect with old ones, as I listen and learn about the deepest community needs and share my vision for advancing solutions and fighting for our district. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/pics%20of%20matt/450055861_17854510086215403_2769979016425773438_n.jpg]
Will you join me in advancing commonsense solutions by helping out our campaign? [https://www.mobilize.us/kleinmannforcongress/]
It's hard to believe that the August 6 primary election is less than a month away! We're adding more volunteer opportunities all the time, which you can view on our Mobilize events page [https://www.mobilize.us/kleinmannforcongress/] . and if you're able to give a little time to help us spread the word, I'd greatly appreciate it.
Stronger together,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/113591/images/kleinmann%20signature.png]
Matt

Coming to the convention yourself? Garage parking is located at Circle Center Mall and the Indianapolis Government Building. Metered street parking is also available. For the most up to date schedule changes, [please refer to our website](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88781403/485119986/-7816984?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzRhYmJiNS04YTQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=47FN_Z0ky1WStTuGS7lwv0Gbq9F6vTVTb62OgmjEo3Q=&emci=8e1c725d-8240-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bc4abbb5-8a40-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535). **** _Republican Rule Raising Healthcare Costs_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88781404/485119987/118194013?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzRhYmJiNS04YTQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=47FN_Z0ky1WStTuGS7lwv0Gbq9F6vTVTb62OgmjEo3Q=&emci=8e1c725d-8240-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bc4abbb5-8a40-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88781407/485119990/118194013?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzRhYmJiNS04YTQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=47FN_Z0ky1WStTuGS7lwv0Gbq9F6vTVTb62OgmjEo3Q=&emci=8e1c725d-8240-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bc4abbb5-8a40-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535) Medicaid expenses have continued to skyrocket in Indiana following last year’s $1 billion shortfall. With the system growing more confusing as residual benefits from COVID expire and more changes are being tacked on, many Indiana residents now fear they will lose coverage. Next January, the state’s 150-person General Assembly will meet to discuss potential spending plans for the next two years. At that time, it is imperative that we have more Democrats in office to fend off Republican’s attempts to enact more regulations. Every Hoosier deserves to have access to affordable care they need to stay healthy. To help us help you, [register to vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88781410/485119993/-1499154792?ref=voteusa_en&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzRhYmJiNS04YTQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=47FN_Z0ky1WStTuGS7lwv0Gbq9F6vTVTb62OgmjEo3Q=&emci=8e1c725d-8240-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bc4abbb5-8a40-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4925535) or check your registration so we can make real change starting at the polls. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. This effort to close the digital divide was possible because of the Biden-Harris Administration’s Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program. The program is a part of the White House’s “Internet for All” initiative,which was established following the passage of the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law in 2021. In addition to providing the new funds for internet expansion, the program has been a huge part of efforts to lower unemployment rates in the state. Despite the support the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law saw prior to its passage, no Republican from Indiana voted for its approval. Instead of working to improve our nation, they are more concerned with promoting their own ideology.

| [](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpPzldcY4QnL55jJyAzBb2VHptlWZ22lUgSolvTaOSYu4dB5FQIxsSsG393titAyfUkQvseKyvFhfifJt1ytmGLdXbopagzaTJU0Wvp0tzCO25gqCzgYIBXhYThoo6TD3UlHUHhe0RX7tdEL4bsusLvVbKkewtcaATdzu_s2ywKBNMZCWJTR3byoeds12tjvkcWSKAjxXYXteSqDcekmAvC-g%3D)

Friends,

I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here - a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. There's so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzWIOr5OUCnqCUAP5ihqUaTuobKZNLZ_FmY95kabU0KbdETY9fQPGt9AfT_B9_eFHd6q11W974AYC8c3-ytAQ7TYI1_zuJsmITJz2ja3N82a74j48KWtYkYjffqGXyc_4OcTuF7-_FPD8n3_HUAbjDfM%3D)
This is a photo of me as a child. I grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. I grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzXtQroS3hQZthQlO8NAziAeHuPz8B_ahmJjFVEhGKnex92opNs5Wyh0Pflax0sF5nP-X8gd0JdJFzLpV74XqNSNYsWcsLcNudN-889vSe9C-zV2__tUV9xUHftPg_Ck_z6hHfieqotJ71KyDOITRjBQ%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzXE7T9WEFsOKjs_8zxIKhn1pliLBbHUN1WogZPlyANauVvH4X-L404YcZcjj7_SZkIbCWXSkSxLKI_wDsYZwTFO11p45ty0qJ118fwFaQhBsjFg9ZpMUVCCZRVR9PMVQ6oZBi6jzt5WVjOrcmvj1Wbs%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzXI6oHdyitUL3obpPLzkD4Pks4i3PG4a9Dj9f_Om8q70QvzY-_jo5H9fquKnpHw1r3fACPVxZhpDRjhSABIM-vtjA7VQuJsu_YbBAP8Q4XpV_sCJZtOc64jUbC-cL7DJl1QwOPZqozm7FVU0jJDoxPI%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzbff-5ydeatQFvev64CfA1KwZSO9Txp3ePiQKkCAlQG2XZ1hqqlsBpd9JoW_vq6ZduG44LZIs71VtDHtaC4i1zb5wYxW31fKfPuyLI0bSVpaHhoF_xgdTNYGecTknDmJKJxBBIKbdmg_uuoqsyEKOOY%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now - a Senator in the United States Senate. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I've seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately - they fail themselves. It's an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots - my family - my hometown - are what got me here. The good and the bad.

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzRN2BXjuxDL3jlEufkvK4UhE7PysV7P-lOEs6qXAejfn4Ey6wrtxasTEvjU6NcE9l0gvhjSx6R67W4oKdY5lfWdgPqvqodPG3wUJT4IlMQWwJal-zem7mYKyPKO6mgvMRCnrXr8LE_FXffpUjG6KBNw%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs leaders who know what it's like to live in a left-behind community, not career politicans who do nothing for the American people.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of why I ran for U.S. Senate: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

[**_It's the honor of my life to serve you in the Senate, and I hope you can make a donation today. It would truly mean the world to me._**](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2ecc75e9d5cc4890a2c6b41ccf62f762&_e=OhqIrvyyhkaBDAW79fHpcJQ_3EVEbymGwL1xB1yP71umiZLyDg0BemsRJxyqiLiLOAyqqJwX1KLFWtCmLhoqgvhrDt3cGHwLwMkamggn859uqGuC3-mrEx8BmYI0UOLiydOZw_2ociUsAeS68jM1GZG-zxpRcA7oIeR4bUlhzrFIgej4Tia-54lNl53r1tCawFSriY9IWd91ZiOPmEUpP-8rThdTA5oM4fAoY81NiwfkDYNEz0br_6tbg42wDXGuxGg5m76kNqIZcV1tGTGxzc9JdS2MgFTxkrR_u5uoDKdBaQwZVtp4ff7sxPreMPaK8EIaa1T5JTct1nI4CEexzofI_3cc7MnN7vazH1L8SaAHSc_GArZNubEkzpgvDAmHNnsn6R-5jK1nN4ENGGaMnUietMO26OktzEGdmtI6IRU%3D)

JD Vance

**Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author.**
Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our

clean_body: Sparknotes | Friends, I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here - a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. There's so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my Hillbilly Elegy. This is a photo of me as a child. I grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. I grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop. My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream. After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University. I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together. All of this brought me to where I am right now - a Senator in the United States Senate. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I've seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent. I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately - they fail themselves. It's an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots - my family - my hometown - are what got me here. The good and the bad. I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs leaders who know what it's like to live in a left-behind community, not career politicans who do nothing for the American people. I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of why I ran for U.S. Senate: leave no Ohioan behind. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read. God bless, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. And Peter, I’ve always said there’s nothing wrong with a little healthy competition. I wanted to win! So, I set a goal and then I read and I read and I read. That summer sparked my love for literature, but it also taught me a thing or two about competition, setting goals, and reaching them. = | = Since I was a little girl, that drive for success has always been ingrained within me. In fact, it is the fuel I use in everything I do. If I can make my home district even just a little bit better than before, that’s more than enough motivation for me. What keeps me going in this work, is a commitment to building a better future for our children, and a better life for our communities. If you send me back to Congress, that’s what I’ll continue to do. Slowing down is simply not in my DNA. So, as we enjoy the sweltering summer days in North Carolina, I want to remind you that even though it may not feel like it now, Election Day is right around the corner. = If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Valerie | = Paid for by Foushee for Congress Valerie Foushee for Congress PO Box 16446 Chapel Hill, NC 27516 United States If you would like to unsubscribe, click here: You can also =.

It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem |
#
Hi, this is Senator Sheldon Whitehouse. **I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate.[I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Tina Smith’s](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88783177/485126176/-1605506409?amount=10&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240712_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOWNmNTMzMi05MDQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SurIRxGR4-jvuWju9opBz_GCweFUeUC4FH_apSzozYk=) – and here’s why.** _It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem._ I recently published a law review article highlighting how this Supreme Court often makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit Republican special interests. Take _Citizens United v. FEC_ as an example. Remember when the Supreme Court justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing in this decision would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong — several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – _and not alter_ – facts and records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. But the current Supreme Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America — like the _Dobbs_ decision, which ended a crucial freedom for women. How are the American people supposed to trust a Supreme Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? **[I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmF1gwv6-W4-MWXzLBBf7VebulKb2kon6lDJKsV21A8VQ_5VndO3ZECi36crlAEHLulaZUaznRk03LrNd80O3b2XQklI3t11mmRB-23Lr4gTcutg9kSedBR5XtxCSH1aXLQ1e6QmoxIn8BSCB4zdntuw%3D%3D)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmrAoa1q6u51QLJtNGrcDFGoNNDIa3xBqhZa-5solCPYWqnARr3ty9tRBk54dBlIXOKr91aaqh6Ro__YI4-VA7uOGNCKiJ6HXxJ31ABZfXJNT1PxG0KkabWqqJMOPmIX8Cv2ieZImcyXMWlGGopUyzDQ%3D%3D)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmH7hUrbQngfuyohTp-R4rZlFIH3iBfepHZ6Uieem-IS7VzuZq37kywq35sJhup9uoTAFBjhKzFcsiO2WN9Al7pFq-SNz8FZ-fPSKubC4q5X4F6kcikAd7L_8Gdbm6Bdj-2TrKObC3YkK4pOBCUPFAKQ%3D%3D)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmUpSuZkzkM9wEoLwvAUy7TkaXu5F0imOtY567tjeBmoaT1zyVZd-1LdGsORst4zXEelWgNhqgYMA_jG8OXa6nK6DGzQHNw3M25W8jC6bwCRF7LwgfafWdOKYdor_c2fkw218Jq8O-SeubJxib__voMQ%3D%3D)

In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCm1Qkz73glQa10Y9K3qPkFuQzlp3JIyfDUh5cmXmFs0uqCYQucxq_47DYM75AHd4Z9WJnb1_5cewrqd2j0N-TTXmhJBFizOGINm_t2mR1W9pjlRsz1Nwqz6QJ4x9TK7IixVszJTaWXJFTfhHiMEX-oOQ%3D%3D)

**As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there.** After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own.

**Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first.**

I've seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I've seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.

**I 'm running for Senate because Pennsylvania and America need a strong leader -- and I have what it takes to do the job which is why** **[I'm hoping you'll pitch in a donation of $17.76 or more today.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmxph5TWk2rJAWEK6kEH0-5HB6yVcdTwY5qUnNKah7yTXrl2JJHClwAIbh56akF4INOixF5BIzZOMqfMyB2J5MMU8ZkTUHP0Jex5BsRGuh2wfcV8S1N2v-bHdShnFsP5l97gmvbVb63u8iU5DWjnnI6g%3D%3D)**

Under the Democrats' leadership, times are tough. We're experiencing skyrocketing inflating, unprecedented crime rates, open borders, and leadership that is destroying the American Dream.

**America deserves better. You deserve better.

It's time for a strong leader who will step up to the plate, put American families first, and fight for the future our great nation deserves.** **[Will you join me today?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmdBI-G89WpZz5G40D8HJ1_DoDg9tGTubRKjyECdqtLHeSvVVzRX11BXFMBAkEcH2dzUMQ71klOiWtlEdHUs6zbmWAAo9vuTmzr4_D8IBMXsAlBdUIo447r1tF64x1XOGEn4lheG9TK0KeOl9ly3lxvg%3D%3D)**

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat vet, 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and business leader. **Now, I 'm running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.**

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmZSI8ui3A00LDp0S9ejjr1o8ebcAkDkTEyUzCClEOkYpxTwG_moOaWRapCQSTOLsKZnqRiL1rkxnsBKkYAu-PAowqGF4r9qG3aDDIkOSm5ltNCeaxcTHlA9H5otDwcA9TqOm4uK32kv_HrxCwliSU_w%3D%3D)
I've been on tough missions, but if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC - and flip the Senate -**I need your help.**

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 in order to show the strength of our movement](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmhzBsIbAgOrZzHMGn5YYI1D_PzT1F5F7r7z9g5A226zDlPS3MCDpoSoHxJjxjBrCQzZArma5NFJMPFqG2X080_1e9LAmwXeKXR0MKBH41S3wQ0UQBuLyDCdMlBwatrzyCRG67Epf24HCx0bGuKZLzDQ%3D%3D)** during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days and months.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmBtOT2siE8QSfoWT3hLt_JXh7WlYM6PSx0pNhFmnUhfC3Rg1b6wE_ko4Y42pJHt2MMlDF070oWtvJCYwdwGr_qtw3BpeQP95xXvQSH6pyJTgNJ4wwv9DY21ieDg-RyVKIBN4kIXR4TNGDGNjhbRAkxg%3D%3D)

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=03ddaa22017f4c53ae6020322505f6ff&_e=DFVh88kuidpIgaN2eJMALHprP2Oqo1ifVF3w9vghe-ToMe3mUislQvUzNCWL_YYctVp0ApqzsxRShjUWzImfGIW4ViQyEPXbs1CgjsKYK4ksGXSJMJP0e2nJ82yAx9_6CJxJ4Gqe_e04gfMQU1AhDvLs5EUzsNB7O0k3OxcXzJAJmbIrYGZWNq1rO7lFECroxDa2WPTTMG0IgR-S0ghSz31fOKxGbK5XzMeCIMoo-3okJJnCVsFe-xfO48IigeCmDtdEKeqUJ_4K8_35bB_Vn6J4zpD8Oi28FlAgUUkrhyXQxQivdocC1bwWUiv05gHFF8jj0_TzSkPoC99juwvyPJxpVaDskQ2-QT-HAN00e-l5-aFLYh-1MxqHVFYBwvjkHJrtxsCyS7Z1_c8AgbGWhw%3D%3D)**

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next Senator.**

clean_body: This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers Friend, As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me. Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer. This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else. After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me. True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission. As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step. In the heat of the moment, even the smallest blister can feel like a mountain to overcome. As a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne, I've been there. After hours of marching, it's not easy to keep pushing through pain. But, no matter what, I remembered how important it was to check my soldiers' feet before my own. Why? Because great leaders ALWAYS put others' needs first. body:
| | |
---
Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, updates on upcoming and recent events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress in breaking down voting barriers, key election updates, and the initiatives shaping Pennsylvania's future.
As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to educate and mobilize voters who then vote every election to make change in our communities. Stay informed with essential election resources and dates as we approach the 2024 General Election on November 5th.

Remember, your voice matters, and we’re here to provide the information and resources needed to shape Pennsylvania’s future.

Thank you for staying informed and engaged! Together, change is possible. When we vote, we win.

---
| | |
---
---
**Gov. Shapiro signs 2024-25 Pennsylvania budget** “The $47.6 billion package includes a compromise on plans to fix Pennsylvania’s unconstitutional school funding system,” as reported by [Penn Capital Star](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9Yg0J2YES5j8Jy9tazUAuaUELZp6IxMVujApoOoRpvIVrhVqGSUjgCKsIXxbrMd1hAaKvjCzSQWD2O3-2FhUZqEsd7PZx8lU01UT1s8o-2Fk3binwPGvB6D5RwMjTnvZ-2F1XntkeWUO1djJvZ9-2BeISHYHlDPEslAILlpfNk5I2il-2FD7t1klDBIfjkIms4rro9eR5or6opc-2FPugS1dHpEnDl2peEeg-3DuUuC_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrY-2BvAPdpI-2Fpi-2FMNx-2F06n6y5e5VFTPAApM2sQqwuCo561m2FAsdB8D1xqdoEiahaHyx7JNXLAAydtUxKrkw-2BxgFad8zcZxMnO-2FlviThY62KkYc5pbdbXHQOIMfD2g-2FeOxkfWTP0n15opBMYj7hnkN5N-2FoRLeaXKJG9jJ8p5f9UeKEU9HlnZTffas7ZxlcsK8Ng4). The spending plan provides $11 billion in K-12 education funding, which is over $1 billion in new funding dedicated to public schools. But it scales back plans to address inequities between rich and poor school districts that were ruled unconstitutional last year. “No one in the room got everything that they wanted. ** Most low-income workers would need to work more than three full-time jobs to afford a two-bedroom apartment in PA, a new report said. The report, _[_Out Of Reach_](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9YkktvIjxlHAkrtNsaSkZix-2FJggm9c2cwWZuUT-2F3X2uhW__WQ_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrY-2BvAPdpI-2Fpi-2FMNx-2F06n6y5e5VFTPAApM2sQqwuCo561njTK0HX-2BiYw8PEcCvPNj1bFj4K9LyIdpxfmH7-2FVUtdDTOCxVyJsKWRRo0NgIh6yLEqeTeHgttWmfBdFKOaK57TMm4lT3aT6avFrCK6q2-2Bncc0SvRkicZPv-2FQPnrZhxPREy2PcLwvfJoH4enLKGTobU)_ , released by the National Low Income Housing Coalition, looked at data to determine the gap between what people in Pennsylvania get paid and how much they need to make to afford housing. clean_body: | | | Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, updates on upcoming and recent events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress in breaking down voting barriers, key election updates, and the initiatives shaping Pennsylvania's future. As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to educate and mobilize voters who then vote every election to make change in our communities. Stay informed with essential election resources and dates as we approach the 2024 General Election on November 5th. Remember, your voice matters, and we’re here to provide the information and resources needed to shape Pennsylvania’s future. Thank you for staying informed and engaged! Together, change is possible. When we vote, we win. | | | Gov. Shapiro signs 2024-25 Pennsylvania budget “The $47.6 billion package includes a compromise on plans to fix Pennsylvania’s unconstitutional school funding system,” as reported by . The spending plan provides $11 billion in K-12 education funding, which is over $1 billion in new funding dedicated to public schools. But it scales back plans to address inequities between rich and poor school districts that were ruled unconstitutional last year. “No one in the room got everything that they wanted. And there are some things we didn’t get done this time. We’re all going to come back and fight for next time.” Said Shapiro. | Election 2024 glossary: What does this mean? Have questions? Check out this election glossary that explains most of the terms politicians, pollsters, and pundits are throwing around regarding the election process. Voters need to be ready and informed to vote on issues and for those who represent them and the needs of our communities. | PA rents are out of reach for most Most low-income workers would need to work more than three full-time jobs to afford a two-bedroom apartment in PA, a new report said. The report, , released by the National Low Income Housing Coalition, looked at data to determine the gap between what people in Pennsylvania get paid and how much they need to make to afford housing. At Pennsylvania's current minimum wage of $7.25 per hour, some of the state's 1.6 million renters would need to work 145 hours per week — or 3.6 full-time jobs — to afford a two-bedroom rental home at the current fair market rate of $1,365. This gap can only change with voters coming to the polls this year and every year. | Urban League's State of Black Pittsburgh addresses voting and housing Black voter participation is key to driving real change in our communities, especially on important issues like housing stability and ensuring policies that improve everyday life. About 100 community members convened for almost three hours to address some of the most pressing issues in the Black community. In an article in TribLive, Kadida Kenner, CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project, is quoted saying: “The importance of voting and community engagement, providing civic education, is the best thing that can be done in this moment.” | | | The ACLU of Pennsylvania and the Public Interest Law Center filed suit against Washington County’s Board of Elections with the goal of reducing the number of people disenfranchised due to errors on their mail ballots. . “The board’s decision to conceal the true status of returned mail ballots with minor but disqualifying errors resulted in needless disenfranchisement,” said ACLU-PA legal director Witold Walczak in a statement. “No government official or agency should knowingly disenfranchise its voters.” . The Pennsylvania Alliance for Retired Americans (PARA) will voluntarily dismiss its lawsuit contesting the rejection of mail-in ballots due to dates on outer return envelopes, following the redesign of the outer return envelope for mail-in and absentee ballots. Voting rights advocates are hopeful the updated design containing the full year “2024” will reduce rejections of mail in ballots for technicalities. For April’s election several mail-in ballots were rejected for not having the hand written 24 on the envelope. PARA maintained that the county’s rejection of these ballots violated Pennsylvania Constitution and state law, especially since the year 2024 was displayed on the ballots themselves.The redesign is seen by PARA “as a victory for voters.” | “Pennsylvania lawmakers have sent Gov. Josh Shapiro a $47.6 billion budget that increases public education spending, funnels new dollars into economic development, provides a one-time boost for transit systems and creates a new college scholarship program." “After a multi-year delay, the state is back on track to upgrade several software systems to manage election data like voter registrations, election-night reporting and campaign finance figures.” “Religion and politics frequently overlap in Reading, an old industrial city in one of the most pivotal swing states of this year’s presidential election. In Pennsylvania, there is early precedent for this kind of thing. The state began as a haven for Quakers and other European religious minorities fleeing persecution. That includes the parents of Daniel Boone, the national folk hero born just miles from Reading, a town where the Latino population is now the majority.” House passes bipartisan legislation that would set stricter deadlines for post-election period To certify election results on time, PA looks to set new deadlines for legal challenges. “In a bipartisan effort to avert a potential crisis in certifying November’s election results, the Pennsylvania House passed a bill Tuesday that would cement the timelines for resolving post-election legal battles and prevent delays in finalizing the state’s electoral votes.” As cannabis legalization remains a work in progress in Pennsylvania, the state Legislative Black Caucus wants to see equity in the recreational marijuana legislation, . "U.S. citizens of color are more likely than white citizens, who do not identify as Latino, to say they lack citizenship documents (3% of people of color compared to 1% of white people) or can’t readily access them (11% of people of color vs. 8% of white people)." "Looking back at the past three Presidential elections, [a report from Lake Research Partners demonstrates] that in the seven states that will likely decide the 2024 election—Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, and Pennsylvania—low-income voter participation was an average of 12 percentage points lower than that of their higher-income voters." The funds sent this year through the new adequacy formula directed to the communities who need it most are critical, and will be used to hire the teachers, tutors, and counselors that students deserve. But the bill admits that 90% of funding gap remains--and does not have a timeline to fill it. | | | | We're Hiring! Join the New Pennsylvania Project (NPP) and be a part of our mission to empower impacted, Black and other communities of color across PA. Help us support every eligible voter to feel compelled to vote. Your work will make a direct impact on civil rights, fair education funding, economic justice, and environmental stewardship. Reach us at jobs@newpaproject.org Our newest hires: | | | | | | Southeastern Pennsylvania 2024 Blue and White Weekend On Saturday (7/13) Kadida Kenner, CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project, will speak at a Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity and Zeta Phi Beta Sorority fundraiser at the The Nile Swim Club. It is July 2024 and the minimum wage has remained stagnant at $7.25/hour since 2009. It's one reason why I stand by this [viral tweet](https://substack.com/redirect/958ebbf7-5beb-488f-be61-54b7a969190e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I tweeted some time ago:
> I'm good with my taxes subsidizing welfare benefits for people who can't afford food. I'm enraged with my taxes subsidizing corporate welfare to businesses that won't pay living wages.
I can already predict the inevitable email responses I'll receive. "_You 're a communist,_" or "_stop hating people for their success_ ," or my personal favorite, "_don 't you get tired of spending other people's money_?" Each of these snarky replies are both deflection, and contrary to the ground reality that the super wealthy have in fact launched class warfare against working people through a rigged tax system, corporate fraud, corporate wage theft, and through a widening and deadly wealth and income inequality. The receipts prove it. And we need to stop it because this is unsustainable.
So, **Let 's Address This**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2372df83-2cef-43f8-b1fc-b19ac3bb4185?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=146446268&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2NDQ2MjY4LCJpYXQiOjE3MjA4MjAyMjQsImV4cCI6MTcyMzQxMjIyNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.DWPFh_IRUfX8P6kOOFgs6iFYcoArRlCANwgSlyKihWA)
## Warfare Through A Rigged Tax System
The fact is, my above tweet is grounded in current reality. And that reality is that the ultra wealthy pay the lowest tax rate of any demographic in America.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a75b625-efbd-44db-8886-92e15338e4ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While the super wealthy paid up to a [94% marginal tax rate post WWII](https://substack.com/redirect/31bb5941-7e98-488a-ae12-a43a2cbb89f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to pre-Reagan, the Reaganomics trickle down scam changed all that to the detriment of working people. And to be sure, that high marginal tax rate did not bankrupt the super wealthy, it did not drive industry out of the country, it did not decimate the job market, and it certainly did not stifle innovation. Instead, it strengthened our economy, grew industry, and established a thriving middle class. Now, the ultra-rich pay "next to nothing" in taxes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7d35cef9-4f48-4eae-b821-91bb866d219f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Warren Buffet famously remarked that he [should not be paying a lower tax rate than his secretary](https://substack.com/redirect/794189c7-b34e-4ca1-b84d-324ac0e068c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but he is. And the scariest part is, this isn't even the worst part of how class warfare by the wealthy is decimating the lives of working people in America. Consider corporate fraud.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ngmzvp7aNN2pzhyYlm67EfA_Efl6DRdlTR4qEkd-xu0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146446268)
## Warfare Through Corporate Fraud
We already know that a major Big Pharma lobby prevents the passage of guaranteed universal healthcare, even though it would save [68,000 American lives and at least $450 Billion](https://substack.com/redirect/ade0a5f1-7729-4c1f-9476-76a9f96d52f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), annually. Now a new report published by the Wall Street Journal documents $50 Billion stolen by insurance corporations via fraud for made up illnesses. Exactly zero executives have or will suffer prison or accountability for this fraud, meanwhile the [parent who stole baby formula to feed their hungry child is spending time in jail](https://substack.com/redirect/d33207be-5497-47ba-b42d-e390d79b45f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Warfare is when billionaires can steal billions while enjoying the cover of Forbes, while destitute parents steal food and suffer the gauntlet of jail.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28b39713-eda9-4f9d-a0b2-892ff756cd08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## Warfare Through Wage Theft
Not content with committing insurance fraud, studies show that corporations annually steal another $50 Billion in wages from working Americans. Once again, zero executives go to prison, zero stores are shut down, and zero policy changes prevent future wage theft. Corporations like Walmart underpay their employees, force them onto welfare, and then steal their wages--all without so much as a slap on the wrist. It's no surprise that taxpayers subsidize Walmart employees with [more than $6.2B in benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/df44354e-3d4f-4425-a623-b46f1a70a814?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because corporations like Walmart refuse to pay a living wage but commit wage theft.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab07f133-e8ac-4a55-94ce-6677147dc497?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ngmzvp7aNN2pzhyYlm67EfA_Efl6DRdlTR4qEkd-xu0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146446268)
## Warfare Through Wealth Redistribution From Working People To The Ultra Wealthy
A detailed study reports the shocking figure of[ $50 Trillion redistributed from from working people to Top 1%](https://substack.com/redirect/be72cd2d-6808-4820-9d4c-aaf5c6dc771f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is through a combination of bailouts for billion dollar corporations who gambled in the economy, absurd tax cuts and subsidies for the ultra wealthy, and exemptions for the wealthy unavailable to the poor. To be clear, the above is not a typo. Over the last 40 years of the Reaganomics trickle down scam, the ultra wealthy have taken _$50 Trillion_ that would have otherwise gone to working Americans. This is unsustainable. It is no wonder that today, [78% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck](https://substack.com/redirect/f4bdc0f3-191a-4f15-85dd-007db5699ab4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These are policies enacted by the super wealthy to hoard their wealth, while working people suffer. This is de facto class warfare.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9875302-8d6b-4d5e-bcbc-546968290624?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## Warfare Through Widening Wealth and Income Inequality
Its should shock every person with a conscience that the trickle down scam has doubled wealth and income inequality over the last quarter century. In fact, by some estimates [wealth and income inequality is worse today than it was before the Great Depression](https://substack.com/redirect/a65363c3-9131-4f73-a8d4-b35a21723f52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In fact, in the near decade since the below cited report was published, combined with the COVID pandemic, the wealthy grew their wealth by another $2.3 trillion, while working people lost more than $2.1 trillion. It does not take a mathematician to see where our wealth went.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b0c32838-0c48-4b59-9cba-b1d832d69b87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
These are facts. This is what class warfare looks like. And yet, these facts are still not the scariest part about this class warfare. Because it isn't just about poverty, it's about the fact that these policies are killing Americans at record rates.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ngmzvp7aNN2pzhyYlm67EfA_Efl6DRdlTR4qEkd-xu0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146446268)
## Warfare Through Enforced Poverty and Death
And thus the scariest part of this war on working people. Ultimately, this massive wealth and income inequality isn't just impacting basic living conditions, it is deadly. Harvard University researchers at the Opportunity Insights project report that [poverty is stripping Americans of decades of life](https://substack.com/redirect/f605ae5d-c129-4385-9bc9-097bb8f1d326?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The richest American men live 15 years longer than the poorest men, while the richest American women live 10 years longer than the poorest women. The gaps between the rich and the poor are growing rapidly over time. From 2001-2014, the richest Americans gained approximately 3 years in longevity, but the poorest Americans experienced no gains.
And this gap is further exacerbated when accounting for race. The Kaiser Family Foundation [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd3f14d-2348-4e6c-85df-b652aa674c3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Life expectancy is lowest for AIAN people at 67.9 years, followed by Black people at 72.8 years, while White and Hispanic people have higher life expectancies of 77.5 and 80 years, respectively, and Asian people have the highest life expectancy at 84.5 years. Life expectancies are even lower for AIAN and Black males, at 64.6 and 69.1 years, respectively.
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/a9254f88-783b-4c1e-be67-00d80a99ff33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
> ---|---|---
Early death is the end result of the unholy fusion of warfare through corporate fraud, corporate wage theft, redistribution of wealth from working people to the ultra wealth, and widening wealth and income inequality.
## Can We Stop This Class Warfare?
I believe the answer is still YES.
**It starts** by accepting the fact that condemning these economic injustices isn't communism, it isn't hating people for success, and it certainly isn't spending other people's money. It is demanding a fair and just economic system where people are not exploited for food, water, shelter, healthcare, clothing, and education--the necessities of life.
**It advances** by building proven policy that works. As mentioned earlier, the middle class boomed (despite Jim Crow America and financial restrictions on women) when the ultra wealthy paid up to a 94% marginal tax rate. Imagine just how much stronger our economy can be today post-Jim Crow and post-1974 Equal Credit Opportunity Act if the ultra wealthy paid their fair share in taxes? In less than a year the IRS has [collected more than $1 billion in back taxes by having the resources to go after millionaire tax cheats](https://substack.com/redirect/6ef26ba0-5a7d-439c-bde3-d5a17904ee1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**And it sustains** by protecting worker's rights and banning the exploitation of life's necessities. That means guaranteeing universal healthcare and paid family leave. Demanding a living wage for all working people in this country. And ensuring corporate executives who commit fraud, wage theft, and wage exploitation, suffer meaningful consequences for their crimes.
Perhaps the ultra wealthy enjoy counting their wealth over and over because they think it will make them immortal? I've long said that we do not suffer from a lack of resources, but due to an excess of greed. Right now what working people are suffering through is de facto class warfare, and it's about time working people won. The path forward is difficult, but the status quo is far more difficult. It is time to end this war on working people, and restore economic justice.

| Yesterday, I took the tough but important step of becoming the first member of a battleground presidential state to call on President Biden to step aside.

This decision wasn’t made lightly, but the stakes of this election are too high to delay any longer. We cannot win the presidency without Michigan, and we cannot win Michigan without my district.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88785735/485134667/-924466477?refcode=BLU_EM_HSC_2024-07-12_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTZmNTRkYy05NjQwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vWukgz2FVT27qQGpXdJNeo1E1PfySe9AnQjO7ZOMnIc=)
Let me be clear: I deeply respect and admire President Biden. His life of public service is a foundation for the strength of the Democratic party, and the past four years have been among the most productive of any president in recent history. But to build on that progress, we must ensure the viability of the Democratic ticket.

Though I deeply respect President Biden’s contributions to our country, I no longer believe in his ability to lead the Democratic party to a decisive victory against Donald Trump. Thank you for staying informed and engaged! Together, change is possible. When we vote, we win.
