clean_body: | | | Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, updates on upcoming and recent events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress in breaking down voting barriers, key election updates, and the initiatives shaping Pennsylvania's future. As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to educate and mobilize voters who then vote every election to make change in our communities. Stay informed with essential election resources and dates as we approach the 2024 General Election on November 5th. Remember, your voice matters, and we’re here to provide the information and resources needed to shape Pennsylvania’s future. Thank you for staying informed and engaged! Together, change is possible. When we vote, we win. | | | Gov. Shapiro signs 2024-25 Pennsylvania budget “The $47.6 billion package includes a compromise on plans to fix Pennsylvania’s unconstitutional school funding system,” as reported by . The spending plan provides $11 billion in K-12 education funding, which is over $1 billion in new funding dedicated to public schools. But it scales back plans to address inequities between rich and poor school districts that were ruled unconstitutional last year. “No one in the room got everything that they wanted. And there are some things we didn’t get done this time. We’re all going to come back and fight for next time.” Said Shapiro. | Election 2024 glossary: What does this mean? Have questions? Check out this election glossary that explains most of the terms politicians, pollsters, and pundits are throwing around regarding the election process. Voters need to be ready and informed to vote on issues and for those who represent them and the needs of our communities. | PA rents are out of reach for most Most low-income workers would need to work more than three full-time jobs to afford a two-bedroom apartment in PA, a new report said. The report, , released by the National Low Income Housing Coalition, looked at data to determine the gap between what people in Pennsylvania get paid and how much they need to make to afford housing. At Pennsylvania's current minimum wage of $7.25 per hour, some of the state's 1.6 million renters would need to work 145 hours per week — or 3.6 full-time jobs — to afford a two-bedroom rental home at the current fair market rate of $1,365. This gap can only change with voters coming to the polls this year and every year. | Urban League's State of Black Pittsburgh addresses voting and housing Black voter participation is key to driving real change in our communities, especially on important issues like housing stability and ensuring policies that improve everyday life. About 100 community members convened for almost three hours to address some of the most pressing issues in the Black community. In an article in TribLive, Kadida Kenner, CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project, is quoted saying: “The importance of voting and community engagement, providing civic education, is the best thing that can be done in this moment.” | | | The ACLU of Pennsylvania and the Public Interest Law Center filed suit against Washington County’s Board of Elections with the goal of reducing the number of people disenfranchised due to errors on their mail ballots. . “The board’s decision to conceal the true status of returned mail ballots with minor but disqualifying errors resulted in needless disenfranchisement,” said ACLU-PA legal director Witold Walczak in a statement. “No government official or agency should knowingly disenfranchise its voters.” . The Pennsylvania Alliance for Retired Americans (PARA) will voluntarily dismiss its lawsuit contesting the rejection of mail-in ballots due to dates on outer return envelopes, following the redesign of the outer return envelope for mail-in and absentee ballots. Voting rights advocates are hopeful the updated design containing the full year “2024” will reduce rejections of mail in ballots for technicalities. For April’s election several mail-in ballots were rejected for not having the hand written 24 on the envelope. PARA maintained that the county’s rejection of these ballots violated Pennsylvania Constitution and state law, especially since the year 2024 was displayed on the ballots themselves.The redesign is seen by PARA “as a victory for voters.” | “Pennsylvania lawmakers have sent Gov. Josh Shapiro a $47.6 billion budget that increases public education spending, funnels new dollars into economic development, provides a one-time boost for transit systems and creates a new college scholarship program." “After a multi-year delay, the state is back on track to upgrade several software systems to manage election data like voter registrations, election-night reporting and campaign finance figures.” “Religion and politics frequently overlap in Reading, an old industrial city in one of the most pivotal swing states of this year’s presidential election. In Pennsylvania, there is early precedent for this kind of thing. The state began as a haven for Quakers and other European religious minorities fleeing persecution. That includes the parents of Daniel Boone, the national folk hero born just miles from Reading, a town where the Latino population is now the majority.” House passes bipartisan legislation that would set stricter deadlines for post-election period To certify election results on time, PA looks to set new deadlines for legal challenges. “In a bipartisan effort to avert a potential crisis in certifying November’s election results, the Pennsylvania House passed a bill Tuesday that would cement the timelines for resolving post-election legal battles and prevent delays in finalizing the state’s electoral votes.” As cannabis legalization remains a work in progress in Pennsylvania, the state Legislative Black Caucus wants to see equity in the recreational marijuana legislation, . "U.S. citizens of color are more likely than white citizens, who do not identify as Latino, to say they lack citizenship documents (3% of people of color compared to 1% of white people) or can’t readily access them (11% of people of color vs. 8% of white people)." "Looking back at the past three Presidential elections, [a report from Lake Research Partners demonstrates] that in the seven states that will likely decide the 2024 election—Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, and Pennsylvania—low-income voter participation was an average of 12 percentage points lower than that of their higher-income voters." The funds sent this year through the new adequacy formula directed to the communities who need it most are critical, and will be used to hire the teachers, tutors, and counselors that students deserve. But the bill admits that 90% of funding gap remains--and does not have a timeline to fill it. | | | | We're Hiring! Join the New Pennsylvania Project (NPP) and be a part of our mission to empower impacted, Black and other communities of color across PA. Help us support every eligible voter to feel compelled to vote. Your work will make a direct impact on civil rights, fair education funding, economic justice, and environmental stewardship. Reach us at jobs@newpaproject.org Our newest hires: | | | | | | Southeastern Pennsylvania 2024 Blue and White Weekend On Saturday (7/13) Kadida Kenner, CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project, will speak at a Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity and Zeta Phi Beta Sorority fundraiser at the The Nile Swim Club. | | 🚨**The NEGOP is funded by building a team and collectively we can make a difference in just 45 days ****Peter.** 🚨 **2024 CONVENTION UPDATE
A Week To Remember**
The 2024 Republican National Convention will be a historic primetime event where Republicans from across the country will gather to nominate President Donald J. Trump and build the energy necessary to launch President Trump to victory in November.

**_What you need to know:_**
* This week, Milwaukee will be front-and-center on the national and world stage as the Convention attracts upwards of 50,000 delegates, staff, volunteers, security, media, and other organizations that will undoubtedly create a significant and positive economic impact for the community, both short and long-term.
* The Republican National Convention will generate an[ estimated $200 million](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=44308587d3&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.tmj4.com/about-us/lighthouse/its-4-days-of-intense-focus-businesses-brace-for-the-economic-impact-of-rnc") in local revenue.
* The RNC worked hand-in-glove with the Wisconsin business community to make the Convention a reality.
* The RNC partnered with many [local subcontractors](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7723510765&e=25844e23a8 "https://dailyreporter.com/2024/06/17/2024-rnc-announces-names-of-subcontractors-suppliers/") and [suppliers](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=aad34a9968&e=25844e23a8 "https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2024/06/17/milwaukee-business-supplies-materials-for-rnc-")[ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=cf6082e28d&e=25844e23a8 "https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2024/06/17/milwaukee-business-supplies-materials-for-rnc-")to assist with the buildout of the Convention complex.
* The RNC ordered over $80,000 of branded [merchandise from a women-owned, Milwaukee-based company](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9325c6e3f8&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.bizjournals.com/milwaukee/news/2023/07/28/area-firm-wins-first-request-for-quote-rnc-pact.html").
* The RNC also brought on a [Wisconsin-based security firm](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=5742670d7d&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.tmj4.com/news/waukesha-county/waukesha-co-business-owner-helps-to-keep-rnc-secure#:~:text=A%20Waukesha%20County%2Dbased%20business,This%20is%20a%20massive%20undertaking.") to help keep Convention guests safe and secure.
* Additionally, the RNC sourced [nearly 40% of our transportation contracts](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7dcccc97a2&e=25844e23a8 "https://biztimes.com/getting-on-the-bus/") within Wisconsin.
* Finally, from [hotels](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=bb9ae0afe2&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.wisn.com/article/milwaukee-hotels-near-capacity-for-rnc-july/60721038"), [to bed & breakfasts](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f0afceb07a&e=25844e23a8 "https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2024/03/15/bed-and-breakfast-reaps-benefits-of-rnc-bookings-"), to [Airbnb's](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=cb6127e9be&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.tmj4.com/news/local-news/people-across-milwaukee-preparing-rentals-airbnbs-for-2024-rnc"), the hospitality industry is seeing [ higher than average occupancy rates](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=e6abe8849e&e=25844e23a8 "https://www.wkow.com/news/milwaukees-largest-hotels-fully-booked-for-the-republican-national-convention/article_02315720-39ad-11ef-a59b-c73801e76768.html").
* Business will come in all shapes and sizes for local companies.
* [Convention delegates](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b013c04451&e=25844e23a8 "https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2024/06/19/a-day-in-the-life-of-an-rnc-delegate")[ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=6fd2c8582d&e=25844e23a8 "https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2024/06/19/a-day-in-the-life-of-an-rnc-delegate")and guests will not only participate in official party business and programming but will take time to immerse themselves in Wisconsin's hospitality, [entertainment](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9118fd1b29&e=25844e23a8 "https://biztimes.com/see-where-rnc-related-events-will-be-held-throughout-the-milwaukee-area/"), [venues](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a49d03b90a&e=25844e23a8 "https://biztimes.com/american-family-field-to-host-massive-rnc-delegation-event/"), cuisine, and much more.
* Fun facts:
* _Over 2,000 delegates will take to the floor to nominate President Donald J. Trump._
* _There will be over 100,000 balloons._
* _Over 20,000 people will witness history on the last night in Fiserv Forum._
* The Convention will lay out President Trump’s vision to restore America.
* Daily themes:
* _Monday: Make America Wealthy Once Again_
* _Tuesday: Make America Safe Once Again_
* _Wednesday: Make America Strong Once Again_
* _Thursday: Make America Great Once Again_
* President Donald J. Trump will usher in a new golden age for America.

**_The bottom line:_**

The 2024 Republican National Convention will undoubtedly continue to build the energy and momentum necessary to drive President Donald J. Trump to victory this fall. Milwaukee, here we come!

**Your contribution to the 45 in 45 Fundraising Campaign will:
\- Door-to-Door Canvassing: We are being the ground game for relational organizing to low propensity voters [Trump Force 47](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ba6bb91a81&e=25844e23a8)
\- Election Security: [Protect the Vote](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=3c9dff664a&e=25844e23a8) \- Increased Poll Watchers to proactively deter election fraud and stand ready with a team of legal counsel for immediate response to nefarious ballot security.
\- Legislative Planning: Preparing solutions to the real problems of Nebraska by drafting our 2025 Legislative Plan. Taxes, education, agriculture, economy, infrastructure, environment, energy, and public safety, will be actively discussed with leaders from across the state in preparation of the 2025 Unicameral Session.

Help us support the next generation of Republican leaders in Nebraska.

Contribute today: [www.ne.gop/45in45](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=be3807a243&e=25844e23a8)

Thank you for growing Team Nebraska.

Best,
The Nebraska Republican Party
1610 N St., Lincoln, NE 68508**

subject: Dr. Cornel West on Frederick Douglass's Legacy: A Call to Action
body:
Dr. West, alongside Larry Sharpe and Maj Toure, will explore the enduring relevance of Frederick Douglass's powerful assertion, "If there is no struggle, there is no progress. Power concedes nothing without a demand." This discussion will delve into the historical and contemporary significance of Douglass's words, examining how they resonate in today's fight for justice and equality.

---
Dear Friends and Supporters,

We are excited to announce that Dr. Cornel West will participate in a crucial panel discussion at FreedomFest 2024. This event offers a unique opportunity to engage with one of the most pressing issues of our time. **Panel Discussion:**
**Title:** _"If Power Concedes Nothing Without a Demand...Then We Demand Freedom"_
**Date:** Saturday, July 13, 2024
**Time:** 12:20 pm - 12:50 pm PDT
**Location:** Room 134/135/136 (MAIN STAGE)
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=-FBJFnBVlCqw7mfnl_3PpHvsV-pUQ6ZbnvHlsWl9qPkUxho-zg12xGx3Yz9rvqtnQW0lLSl-3To03JpNMex6oosEGhK6CI-GNAGxjX6tlIk&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=freedom_fest&n=2 "Learn More") [Learn More](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=-FBJFnBVlCqw7mfnl_3PpHvsV-pUQ6ZbnvHlsWl9qPkUxho-zg12xGx3Yz9rvqtnQW0lLSl-3To03JpNMex6oosEGhK6CI-GNAGxjX6tlIk&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=freedom_fest&n=2)
---
**A Historic Dialogue:** Dr. West, alongside Larry Sharpe and Maj Toure, will explore the enduring relevance of Frederick Douglass's powerful assertion, "If there is no struggle, there is no progress. Power concedes nothing without a demand." This discussion will delve into the historical and contemporary significance of Douglass's words, examining how they resonate in today's fight for justice and equality. **The Legacy of Frederick Douglass:** Frederick Douglass, a former enslaved person who became a leading abolitionist and statesman, understood that progress requires relentless demand and struggle. His life and work epitomize the fight against systemic oppression and the pursuit of liberty. Douglass's commitment to justice led him to navigate various political affiliations and support independent movements when necessary, demonstrating a clear focus on principles over party loyalty. This panel will reflect on Douglass's legacy, drawing parallels between his era and our current socio-political climate, and highlight the importance of maintaining an independent and principled stance in the fight for justice and equality. **Dr. Cornel West's Perspective:** As a prominent intellectual and activist, Dr. West brings a profound understanding of moral and social justice to the discussion. His campaign for the 2024 Presidential race highlights the urgent need to confront our nation's moral bankruptcy and spiritual crisis, driven by a political system that often values profits over people and the planet. Dr. West advocates for policies designed by and for the people, free from the influence of corporate and special interests.
---
| [](http://www.cornelwest2024.com/100_days?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=freedom_fest&n=3 "First 100 Days in Office") [First 100 Days in Office](http://www.cornelwest2024.com/100_days?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=freedom_fest&n=3)
---
**A Call to Action:** This panel is not just a conversation but a call to action. Dr. West’s independent candidacy embodies a commitment to uniting movements that seek justice beyond the confines of the corporate-dominated two-party system. It is an invitation to all who believe in the power of collective action to join us in demanding freedom and justice for all. **Reflect and Act:** While direct participation in the discussion may not be possible for everyone, we encourage you to reflect on the themes and insights shared. Consider how Frederick Douglass's words apply to our current struggles and how you can contribute to the ongoing fight for justice in your community. **Stay Engaged:** Your continued support and engagement are crucial as we strive to create a just and equitable society. Thank you for your unwavering support. Together, we can make history and pave the way for a brighter future. In solidarity, Team **WEST/ABDULLAH** 2024

Douglass's commitment to justice led him to navigate various political affiliations and support independent movements when necessary, demonstrating a clear focus on principles over party loyalty. Congress has already used its constitutional authority to change the size of the Supreme Court seven times.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2268%2E4032634%2EGjw9TT)
---
From the filibuster to the Electoral College, the Republican party uses every tool they can to defy the will of the people — to make sure they can control Congress and the White House even when they get fewer votes. And they’ve hijacked the Supreme Court, too. Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell stole two seats on the Supreme Court so they can ram through an unpopular, extreme agenda: >From overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , to giving the President free rein to abuse the power of the presidency without constraint, just to name a couple of their recent egregious decisions. When the Supreme Court has gotten this far out of sync with American values, then it’s time to expand the Supreme Court and pull it back toward the mainstream. Congress has already used its constitutional authority to change the size of the Supreme Court seven times. Court expansion isn’t new. It isn’t radical. It’s what we must do to rein in a Court that Republicans packed and that clearly doesn’t feel limited by the rule of law. [**For the sake of our democracy, we must act now. Add your name if you agree: It’s time to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-scotus-reform/?source=EMZ21L_SUP_E_20240712_V1S1&t=8&akid=2268%2E4032634%2EGjw9TT) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-scotus-reform/?source=EMZ21L_SUP_E_20240712_V1S1&t=9&akid=2268%2E4032634%2EGjw9TT)
---
The American people have lost confidence in the Court. And for good reason, with the Court’s dangerous decisions on abortion rights, climate action, gun safety, and more. They’re anti-union, they’re anti-consumer, and they've empowered corporations more than ever before — giving them religious liberty rights and letting them spend gobs of money to influence the political process.
Not to mention, Justices on the Court have been accused of ethical violation after ethical violation — accepting lavish travel opportunities on private jets, superyachts, and at exclusive resorts from GOP megadonors.
Rebalancing the Court is a necessary step to restore its credibility as an independent institution, one that works for the American people and not just for the wealthy and the powerful.
Engraved on the entrance of the Supreme Court is a simple phrase: “equal justice under law.” Americans deserve a Court committed to that fundamental idea. One that values the settled constitutional rights of every American. One that protects democracy, instead of undermining it. One that gives working parents and millionaire executives the same fair shake. This extremist Court has shown that it is not interested in advancing the equal administration of justice. It’s time to rebalance the Supreme Court to create one that is.
Expansion is the only way to rebalance the Court after Republicans stole two seats and undermined its legitimacy.
[**I’ll keep up the fight, but I can’t do it alone. Add your name to say you’re in this fight to expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats and help defend our democracy.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-scotus-reform/?source=EMZ21L_SUP_E_20240712_V1S1&t=10&akid=2268%2E4032634%2EGjw9TT)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
